verses.text: Hihte pen Egypt gam sungah Yaaqob tawh a lut Israyl’ tapate minte ahi hi; amau innkuan ciat tawh amaute Yaaqob tawh a pai uh hi:
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, leh Yahdah,
Issachar, Zebulun, leh Benyamin,
Dan, Naphtali, Gad, leh Asher ahi hi.
Yaaqob’ khanggui pana hong pai tapa khempeuh pen mi 70 pha a, Yahseph ahih leh Egypt gam sungah na omkhin hi.
Tu-in Yahseph leh a sanggamte khempeuh leh tua khangmi khempeuh si ta a,
Ahih hangin Israyl mite pungin, tampi-in khang uh a, tampi pha-in a thahatna uh nakpitakin khang hi; tua gam ah amaute dim uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Egypt gam ah Yahseph a thei lo kumpi thak khat hong thahat a,
amah in a mite kiangah, “En un, Israyl’ suan mite pen eite sangin tamzaw-in thahatzaw uh hi.

Hong pai un! Eite in amaute pilvang takin i hih kei leh amaute tampi takin hong khangzaw kan lai ding a, gal piang leh tua ciangin amaute i galte tawh kipawlin eite hong do kha ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin amaute’n hih gam a nusia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in zawhthawh nasepna tawh amaute a nengniam dingin amaute tungah nasem-ukte a koih hi; amaute in Pharaoh aa ding van koihna khuapite bangin Pithom leh Rameses a lam uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute a kinenniam semsem ciangin amaute tampi pha zaw-in a khang semsem zaw lai uh hi. Tua ahih manin Egypt mite in Israyl mite lipkhapin a kihta mahmah uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Egypt mite in Israyl mite khauhtakin netniamna tawh na semsak uh hi.
Amaute in buanman, leiseek leh lo sunga nasep namkim khempeuh tawh amaute nuntakna haksasak uh hi. Amaute sepna khempeuh ah Egypt mite in hehpih vet loin amaute a zang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Egypt’ kumpipa in Hebrew mite aa dingin naudomte, a masa min pen Shiphrah leh a nihna’ min pen Puah-te kiangah,
a gen inah, “Hebrew numeite aa dingin naudom nasep na semin nausuahna tutphah tungah amaute na muh uh ciangin tua pen pasal ahi leh that unla, ahi zongin numei ahih leh nungtasak un,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin naudomte in Yahweh zahtak uh ahih manin, Egypt kumpipa in amaute a thupiak bangin gamta loin, amaute in ta pasalte a nungtasak veve uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Egypt kumpipa in naudomte samsak a, amaute kiangah, “Ta pasalte a nungta dingin phalin hih bangin gamta na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin naudomte in Pharaoh dawng a, “Hebrew numeite pen Egypt numeite bang hilo uh a, amaute cidamin thahat uh a, naudomte a tun ma-in a suakkhin uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh pen naudomte tungah migi a, Amah in mite tampi phasak ahih manin amaute a tamzaw semsem uh hi.
Naudomte in Yahweh zahtak uh ahih manin, Yahweh in amaute tungah suanlekhak a pia hi.

Tua tak ciangin Pharaoh in a mite khempeuh thupia-in a gen inah, “Hebrew mite tung pana a piang ta pasal peuhmah gun sungah na paai ding uh a, ahih hangin tanu peuhmah na nungtasak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Levi inn sung pan mi khat in Levi numei khat tenpih a,
Numei nu gai-in, tapa khat a nei hi. Tua nu in a pasal tawh ta melhoih khat a neih lam a muh ciangin, amah in kha thum sung a seel hi.

Ahih hangin amah in sawtveipi a seel zawh nawn loh ciangin, amah in naungek aa dingin phaipheek lawh khat bawlin, buan leh kultal tawh zut hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in naungek tua sungah sial a, Nile gun dung nawl-a phaikungte lakah a ngasuk hi;
Ama tungah bang kicih ding hiam cih a thei dingin a gamlasim khat ah a sanggamnu ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin Pharaoh tanu kisil dingin Nile gun ah hong paisuk a, ama silate gun dungah lam a siau uh hi. Tua tak ciangin amah in pumpeng; lauluang, lakah tua lawh mu a, a la dingin amah in a sila numei a sawl hi.
Amah in tua a hon ciangin naungek mu-a, naungek a kap hi. Tua ahih manin amah in naungek hehpih a, “Hih nau pen Hebrew mite ta khat ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin naungek’ sanggamnu in Pharaoh’ tanu kiangah gen a, “Kei pai-in nang aa dingin naungek a khoi dingin Hebrew nupi khat ka sam ding hiam?” a ci hi.
Pharaoh’ tanu in ama kiangah gen a, “Pai in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin tua numei no pai a, naungek’ nu a sam hi.
Tua tak ciangin Pharaoh’ tanu in tua nu kiangah, “Hih nau lakhia inla, kei aa dingin khoi in. Keimah in na thaman nang kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin nupi nu in naungek la-in a khoi hi.

Nau hong khangin tua nu in amah pen Pharaoh’ tanu kiangah paipih a, amah tua nu tapa a suak hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a min Mosheh a phuak hi. Tua pen Kaikhia a cihna ahi hi. A gen inah, “Bang hang hiam cih leh tui panin amah ka kaikhia hi” a ci hi.
Tu-in Mosheh a khan ciangin a mipihte kiangah amah pai a, amaute nasep gimna a mu hi. Tua ciangin Egypt mi khat in ama sanggamte khat ahi Hebrew mi khat a sat mu hi.
Tua ahih manin amah khuadak kawikawi-in kuamah a muh loh ciangin, amah in Egypt mipa that a, sehnel sungah a seel hi.
A zingciang amah a paikhiat ciangin Hebrew mi nih na kilai uh a, amah in a gamta khial pa’ kiangah, “Bang dia na mipih Hebrew mipa vuavua na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amah in, “Kua in kote a uk ding leh thu hong khen dingin nang hong koih ahi hiam? Egypt mipa na thah bangin kei that hong sawm na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Mosheh lau a, “Hih thu hong kithei taktak hi,” ci-in ngaihsun hi.
Hih thu Pharaoh in a zak ciangin, amah in Mosheh thah ding a hanciam hi. Ahih hangin Pharaoh kiang panin Mosheh tai-in, Midian gam ah pai a, tuikhuk khat gei-ah a tusuk hi.
Tu-in Midian siampi khat in tanu sagih a nei hi. Amaute tuikhuk ah hong pai-in tui tawi uh a, a pa uh tuuhonte tui pia dingin kuangzawnte a dim uh hi.
Ahih hangin tuucing pawlkhat hong pai uh a, amaute a hawlkhia hi. Tua tak ciangin Mosheh dingto a, amaute hunkhia-in amah in amaute tuuhonte tui piaksak hi.
Amaute a pa uh Reuel kiangah a ciahkik ciangun amah in amaute kiangah, “Note tuni nong ciahbaih uh a bangci bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Amaute in dawng a, “Egypt mi khat in tuucingte kiang panin kote hong honkhia-in tui zong hong tawisakin tuuhonte tui hong piaksak hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in a tanute kiangah dong a, “Amah koi-ah om ahi hiam? Bang hangin mipa hong paisan na hi uh hiam? An hong nek theih nadingin amah va sam un,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh tua mipa tawh a om khop ding thukim a, amah in Mosheh tungah a tenpih dingin a tanu Zipporah pia hi.

Tua nu in Mosheh tawh tapa khat nei a, Mosheh in a min Gershom a phuak hi. Tua pen Tua munah Khualmi a cihna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Gamdang khat ah kei khualmi khat ka suakkhin hi,” a ci hi.
Hun sawtveipi sungin Egypt kumpipa si hi. Tua ciangin Israyl mite sila ahihna hangun tau-in a kiko uh hi. Saltanna hangin amaute huhna ngenin a kikona uh Yahweh kiangah tung hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in amaute tauna za-a, Yahweh in Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob tawh Ama thuciamna a phawk hi.
Yahweh in Israyl mite ensuk a, Yahweh in amaute aa dingin a lunghimawh hi.

headings.text: Mosheh’ tungah Yahweh in A Min Gen

verses.text: Tu-in Mosheh in Midian siampi khat ahi a sungpa Yethro’ tuuhon a cing hi. Amah in sehnel gam khen ah a tuute paipihin Yahweh’ mual Horeb tung hi.
Tua munah sawlbawk khat meikuang sung panin Yahweh’ vantungmi ama tungah kilang hi. Mosheh in en a, kalai, sawlbawk a kat hangin kangtum lo hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in, “Bang hangin sawlpang kangtum lo hiam, kei panin hih a lamdang ka muh va en dih ning,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Amah in a en dingin a paina Yahweh in a muh ciangin sawlbawk sung panin amah sam a, “Mosheh! Mosheh!” a ci hi. Amah in, “Hiah om ing,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in, “Hih mun ah a naizaw-in hong pai kei in. Na khe panin na khedapte suahkhia in, bang hang hiam cihleh na dinna mun lei siangtho ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Amah in, “Kei pen na pa vantunga om Pa, Abraham’ Pa, Isaac’ Pa, Yaaqob’ Pa ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Mosheh in Yahweh en ngam lo ahih manin a maitang a seel hi.
Yahweh in, “Egypt gam sunga Ka mite a kinetniamna Ka mukhin taktak a, sila-ukte hangin amaute kikona Ka zakhin hi. Amaute thuakna Ka awlmawh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Egypt mite gam panin a lakhia ding leh tua gam panin a hoih a tanzau leitang, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luanna gam Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite, leh Yebus mite’ tenna ah amaute a paipih dingin Kong paisukkhin ta hi.
Tu-in, en in; Israyl mite’ kikona Kei kiang hong tungkhin a, Egypt mite in amaute a netniamnate ka mukhin ta hi.
Tu-in hong pai inla, pai in! Ka mi, Israyl mite Egypt gam panin a lakhia dingin Pharaoh kiangah nang kong sawl hi.
Ahih hangin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Kei Pharaoh kiangah pai-in Egypt gam panin Israyl mite a paikhiatpih dingin kei kua ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahweh in, “Nang Kong ompih ding hi. Hih pen nangma aa dingin nang Kong sawlna lim hi ding hi. Egypt gam panin mite na paikhiatpih ciangin, nangmah in hih mualtung ah Yahweh na bia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Israyl mite kiangah kei va pai-in amaute kiangah, ‘Na pate’ Vanglian Pa in note kiangah kei hong sawl hi,’ ci leng amaute in, ‘A min bang ahi hiam?’ ci-in hong dong leh keimah in amaute kiangah bang gen ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Keimah ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Amah in, “Hih thu pen Israyl mite kiangah hi bangin na gen ding hi: ‘Yahweh in note kiangah kei hong sawl hi’ ci in,” a ci hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah gen lai a, “Hih zong Israyl mite kiangah na gen ding hi, ‘Yahweh, na pate Vantung Pa, Abraham’ Vanglian Pa, Isaac’ Vanglian Pa, Yaaqob’ Vanglian Pa in note tungah kei hong sawlkhin hi. Hih pen Ka Min hi tawntung a, hih pen Keimah hong kiphawk tawntungna ahi hi: Hih min tawh khang khat panin khang khat, khang tawntungin keimah hong kiphawk ding ahi hi.

Pai in, Israyl Upate kaikhawmtuah inla amaute tungah, ‘Yahweh, na pate’ Vanglian Pa; Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob-te Vanglian Pa kei tungah hong kilangkhin-in a gen inah, ‘Keimah in note kong cing gige a, Egypt gam sunga note hong kibawlna ka mukhin hi,

note gentheihna Egypt gam panin Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite leh Yebus mite’ gam bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luanna leitang ah note hong paipih dingin ka kiciamkhin zo hi,’ ci hi,’ hong ci hi.

Israyl Upate in na thu hong ngai ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin nang leh upate Egypt kumpipa kiangah na pai ding uh a, ama kiangah, “Yahweh, Hebrew mite’ Vanglian Pa in kote hong kimuhpih zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin kote Vantung Pa, Yahweh tungah biakpiakna ka piak theih nadingun sehnel gam ah kote ni thum khualzinna hong neisak in,” va ci un.
Ahih hangin Egypt kumpipa in note hong paisak loh ding lam ka thei hi. Khut vanglian khat in zawhthawh thu tawh amah ahih kei buang leh cih loh piang lo ding hi.
Tua ahih manin, Keimah in ka khut Ka zankhia ding a, amaute tunga Ka hih ding Keima na lamdangte khempeuh tawh Egypt mite Ka vatmang ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in note hong paisak ding hi.
Egypt mite muhna ah Israyl mite maipha Ka pia lai ding hi. Tua ahih manin note na paikhiat uh ciangin khut-hawm guak tawh na paikhia kei ding uh hi.

Numei peuhmah in a vengte leh ama inn sunga ompak mite kiang panin na tapate leh na tanute na guat ding uh ngun leh kham leh puante na ngen ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin note in Egypt mite’ na na sut ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in dawng a, “Amaute in kei hong um lo-in ahih keileh ka thu hong ngai kei leh e? ‘Nang tungah Yahweh hong kilang lo hi,’ amaute in ci leh,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Na khuta bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Mosheh in “Ciangkhut khat,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Leilak ah lawn in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in leilak ah tua pen lawn a, gul khat a suak hi; tua gul kiang panin Mosheh a taikhia hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Na khut zankhia inla a mei panin man in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah in a khut zankhia-in man a, a khut sungah ciangkhut khat a suakkik hi.
“Hih bang hi leh amaute in Yahweh, a pate uh Vanglian Pa, Abraham’ Pa, Isaac’ Pa, Yaaqob’ Pa nang tungah a kilat khitna a um ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Tu-in na khut na puantualpi sunglamah koih in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Mosheh in a khut a puantualpi sungah a koih hi; amah in a lak khiat ciangin, en in, a khut phak a, vuk tawh kibang hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Tu-in na khut na puantualpi sungah koihkik in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a khut a puan sunglamah koihkik hi; Amah in a lakkhiat ciangin a cilesa dangte mah bangin damkik hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Amaute in nang hong um lo-in lim masa na lahna a thudon kei leh amaute in lim nihna na lahna um thei ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin amaute in hih lim tenih nangawn um loin, na thu lah hong ngaih kei uh leh, tua ciangin Nile gun panin tui la inla lei keu tungah sungsuk in. Gun pana na lak tui pen lei keu tungah sisan suak ding hi.

Tua ciangin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Yahweh aw, a beisa hun ah hitaleh Na nasempa’ tungah nong hopih hun dong hitaleh cikmahin kei thugen siam sia khat ka hi ngei kei hi; Kei pen pau zekai leh dang-awk mi ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Kua in mihing, kam pia hiam? Kua in amah bengngongsak-a pau thei losak ahi hiam? Khua a musak, mit a tawsak kua ahi hiam? Tua pen Keimah, Yahweh hilo ka hi hiam?”
Tu-in pai in! Nang Kong huh ding a, bang gen ding cih Kong hilh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in, “Yahweh aw, tua sangin hehpihna-in tua a sem ding midang khatpeuh sawl zaw in!

Tua tak ciangin Mosheh tungah Yahweh heh a, Amah in, “Levi mi Aaron pen na sanggampa hilo ahi hiam? Amah in Yahweh’ thukhamte a hilh ding Ka thei hi. Ngai in, nang hong dawn dingin amah hong paikhia khin hi; amah in nang hong muh ciangin a lungsim sungah amah kipak ding hi.
Tu-in, nangmah in ama kiangah thu genin ama kam sungah Ka kammalte na koih ding hi. Keimah in nangma kam leh ama kam ka ompih ding a, bang sem ding cih Keimah in kong hilh ding hi;
Tua ciangin amah in nang taangin mite tungah thu gen ding a, amah pen na kam a hi ding hi; nang pen ama tungah Yahweh kiang panin a lamlak khat na hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin hih ciangkhut tawh nalamdang na bawl theih nadingin tua ciangkhut tawi in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Mosheh paikhia-in a sungpa Yethro kiangah ciahkik a, ama kiangah, “Ka mipihte khat beek a nuntak lai-a leh, cih a en dingin kei hong paisak inla, Egypt gam sunga om amaute kiangah hong ciahkiksak in,” a ci hi. Yethro in Mosheh kiangah, “Lungmuang takin ciah in,” a ci hi.
Midian gam sungah Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Pai in, Egypt ah ciahkik in. Bang hang hiam cihleh nang hong that nuam mi khempeuh sikhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in a zi leh a tapate la-in laa khat tungah tuangsak a, Egypt gam ah kileh dingin a kipan uh hi. Mosheh in Yahweh’ ciangkhut a khutin a tawi hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Egypt ah na ciahkik ciangin, sep theihna vang Kong piaksa na lamdangte khempeuh Pharaoh mai-ah na bawl ding phawk in. Ahih hangin Keimah in mipite a paisak loh nadingin a lungtang ka khauhsak ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin nangmah in Pharaoh kiangah, “Yahweh gen hih bang ahi hi: ‘Israyl pen Ka tapa masa ahi hi;
Ka tapa na paisak nadingin kong ci hi, tua hileh amah in Kei hong bia thei ding hi. Nangmah in amah na paisak kei leh keimah in na ta masa ahi na tapa ka that ding hi, ci hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh’ Inn ah Yahweh dawntuah dingin a paina lampi ah, mihon khat in amah a thah sawm hi.
Mosheh in a tapa vundawn a atsak na hangin Zipporah in amah hiamgam man hi. Tua nu in Mosheh’ khe ah tua vundawn paai-in a gen inah, “Nang pen kei tungah sisan tawh mopa na hi hi!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Mosheh tua lai mun panin taikhia a, Zipporah in, “Nang pen sisan tawh mopa na hi hi!” a cih ciangin vun-atna tawh kisai a gen ahi hi.
Yahweh in Aaron kiangah, “Sehnel gam sungah Mosheh dawn dingin pai in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amah pai a, Yahweh’ mual ah amah dawnin a nam hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in amah a sawlkhiakhin Yahweh’ kammalte khempeuh leh Amah in a thupiaksa limte khempeuh Aaron a gen hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh leh Aaron in Israyl mi upate khempeuh kaikhawm uh a,
Yahweh in Mosheh tunga a gensa kammalte khempeuh amaute tungah Aaron in a gen hi. Amah in mipite muhna ah limte zong lak a, mipite in a um uh hi.
Israyl mite Yahweh in awlmawh-in, Amah in amaute gentheihna a muhkhitna amaute in a theih uh ciangin a lu uh kunsukin a bia uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Pharaoh kiangah Mosheh leh Aaron pai uh a, “Hih pen Vanglian Yahweh, Israyl Pa’ genna hi bang ahi hi: ‘Sehnel gam ah amaute in Kei tungah pawi khat hong kham theih nadingun Ka mite paisak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pharaoh in, “Ama thu mang a, Israyl ka paisak nadingin Yahweh na cih uh kua ahi hiam? Ken Yahweh ka thei kei hi! Israyl-te ka paisak kei ding hi!” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin amaute in, “Hebrew mite Vanglian Pa in kote tawh hong kimukhin zo hi. Sehnel gam ah ni thum khualzin ding hong phal inla, Yahweh tungah biakpiakna hong neisak in; tua bang hi keileh Amah in cinatna ahih keileh namsau tawh eite hong vatmang kha ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Egypt kumpipa in amaute kiangah, “Mosheh leh Aaron aw, bang hangin mite a nasepna panin samkhia ding na hi hiam? Na nasepna uh ah paikik un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pharaoh in, “En un, gamsung mite tam mahmah a, nasepna panin amaute na khawlsak sawm uh hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ni mah-in Pharaoh in mipi nasem-ukte kiang leh thunei makaite kiangah hih bangin thupia a,
“Leiseek bawl nadingin nidanga na piak bangun buhtu na pia nawn kei ding uh hi. Amaute paisak unla amau leh amau in buhtu kaikhawm tawm hen.

Ahih hangin tuma-a amaute leiseek bawlzah mah na bawlsak ding uh kisam hi. Amaute aa dinga a kisehzah note in na khiam kei ding uh hi. Amaute thadah uh hi! Tua hangin amaute kiko uh a: ‘Kote hong paisak inla ka Pa uh tungah biakpiakna hong piasak un,’ a ci uh hi.
Amaute na sepna haksasak un, tua hileh tua munah mite na kisemsak ding a, zuau thute ngai-in dingding lo ding uh hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin nasem-ukte leh mipi makaite paikhia uh a, mipite kiangah, “Pharaoh in ci hi: Keimah in note buhtu kong pia nawn kei ding hi.
Pai unla na zon theihna peuh uh ah no buhtu ciat kaikhawm un; ahih hangin na nasep uh themzong kikhiam tuan lo ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin buhtu-a a kizang thei buhkung a kaikhawm dingin mipite Egypt leitang khempeuh ah kithehthang mang uh hi.
Nasem-ukte in amaute a manlang nadingin nawh hehu uh a, “Buhtu na ngah lai uha bangin nisim ai dinga a kisehzah na nasep uh zo un,” a ci uh hi.
Pharaoh’ nasem-ukte in a teel Israyl mi nasem makaite kisat a, “Bang hangin tu ciang dong, leiseek bawl ding na nasep khempeuh uh hih khin nai lo na hi uh hiam?” ci-in kidong hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl mi makaite Pharaoh kiangah pai-in thuum uh a, “Hih bang dan tawh na nasemte bang hangin hong bawl na hi hiam?
Na nasemte tungah buhtu hong kipia nawn lo a, amaute in, ‘Leiseek bawl un!’ hong ci lai uh hi. Na nasemte hong kisatsat a, ahih hangin amah pen nangma mite ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pharaoh in amaute kiangah, “Note na thadah uh hi! Note na thadah uh hi! Tua hangin note in, ‘Yahweh tungah biakpiakna pia dingin kote hong paisak un’ na ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in pai unla na sem un! Note tungah buhtu hong kipia lo ding hi; ahih hangin note in leiseek a mal ngeina zah mah na bawl hamtang ding uh hi.
“Nisim a sepding a kisehzah leiseek zah na khiam kei ding uh hi,” cih a kigen khit ciangin, Israyl mi nasem makaite in amaute thu haksapi sungah a om lam mu uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Pharaoh kiang panin a paikhiat uh ciangin, amaute tawh a kimu dingin a ngak Mosheh leh Aaron tawh a kimu uh hi.

Nasem makaite in amaute kiangah, “Yahweh in note hong enin thu hong khen hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh note in Pharaoh leh a nasemte tungah kote a khialin nong bawl uh a, kote hong kithat nadingin namsau amaute khut sungah na koih uh hi,”a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh kiangah Mosheh kiheikik a, “Yahweh aw, bang hangin hih mite tungah haksatna; buaina, lunggimna, puak na hi hiam? Hih bang dingin kei hong sawl na hi hiam?
Pharaoh kiangah Nangma Min tawh thugenin ka pai-a kipan, amah in hih mite tungah haksatna; buaina, lunggimna, tun a, Nangmah in Na mite na honkhia het kei hi,” a ci hi.

headings.text: Mosheh kiangah Yahweh in a Min Genkik

verses.text: Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Tu-in Pharaoh tungah ka hih ding na mu ding hi. Ka vanglian khut hangin amah in amaute paisak ding hi. Ka vanglian khut hangin amah in a gamsung panin amaute hawlkhia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin, ama kiangah, “Keimah Yahweh ka hi hi.
Abraham’ tung, Isaac tung, leh Yaaqob’ tungah Yl Shaddai-in; Thahatpen Vanlianpa-in, kilangin, amaute tungah Ka Min Yahweh tawh kitheisak hilo ka hi hiam?
Amaute khualmi ahihna mun amaute khualzinna gam ahi Canaan gam amaute tungah piak dingin amaute tawh Ka thuciamna zong Ka kipsak hi.
Tua bek tham loin Egypt mite in salsuahna sungah a kep uh Israyl mite tauna zong Ka zakhin ta a, Keimah in Ka thuciamna ka phawkkhin hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Israyl mite kiangah gen in, “Keimah Yahweh ka hi a, Egypt mite khut nuai panin Keimah in note kong lakhia ding hi. Amau sal hihna panin kong khahkhia ding a, a kizankhia khut leh vanglian thukhen nasepna tawh note kong honkhia ding hi.
Keima mi dingin note kong la ding a, Kei pen note vantung Pa Ka hi ding hi. Tua tak ciangin Egypt mite khut nuai panin note hong lakhia Keimah Yahweh na Pa uh Ka hihna nong thei ding uh hi.
Abraham, Isaac, leh Yaaqob tungah piak dinga Ka khut liikin Ka ciamna gam sungah note kong paipih ding hi; tua pen note tungah na neih dingun kong pia ding hi: Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in Israyl mite tungah hih thu a genkik hi; ahih hangin amau’ lungsim kitapna leh kibawlsia in a kimatna uh hangin amaute in Mosheh’ thugen ngai lo uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopih-in a gen inah:
“Pai inla, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh kiangah ama gam sung panin Israyl mite amah in paikhiatsak hamtang nadingin gen in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Israyl mite nangawn in ka thu hong ngai kei uh a, tua ahih manin bangci bangin kei pau-awkpi-a ka thugen Pharaoh in hong ngai ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tu-in Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah Israyl mite thu leh Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh’ thu gen a, Amah in Egypt gam panin Israyl mite a paikhiatpih nadingin amaute thu a pia hi.
Hihte pen amau pate’ innkuan lutangte ahi hi: Israyl ta masa Reuben’ tapate pen Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, leh Carmi ahi hi. Hihte pen Reuben’ behte ahi hi.
Simeon’ tapate pen Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yachin, Zohar, leh Canaan numei’ tapa Shaul ahi hi. Hihte pen Simeon’ behte ahi hi.
Hihte pen amau suah dante tawh kizui-in Levi tapate’ minte ahi hi: Gershon, Kohath, leh Merari ahi hi. Levi kum 137 nungta hi.
Gershon’ tapate pen amau behte tawh kizui-in Libni leh Shimei ahi hi.
Kohath’ tapate pen Amram, Izhar, Hebron, leh Uzziel ahi hi. Kohath kum 133 nungta hi.
Merari’ tapate pen Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi. Hihte pen amaute suahdan tawh kizui-in Levi’ behte ahi hi.
Tu-in Amram in a pa’ sanggamnu Yahchebed tenpih a, tua nu in amah tawh Aaron leh Mosheh a nei hi. Amram kum 137 nungta hi.
Izhar’ tapate pen Korah, Nepheg leh Zichri ahi hi.
Uzziel’ tapate pen Mishael, Elzaphan, leh Zithri ahi hi.
Aaron in Naashon sanggamnu Amminadab’ tanu Elisheba tenpih a, tua nu in amah tawh Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, leh Ithamar a nei hi.
Korah’ tapate pen Assir, Elkanah, leh Abiasaph ahi hi. Hihte pen Korah mite behte ahi hi.
Aaron’ tapa Eleazar in Putiel’ tanute khat tenpih a, tua nu in amah tawh Phinehas a nei hi. Hihte pen amau behte tawh kizui-in Levi mite innkuan lutangte ahi hi.
Hih mite nih pen Yahweh in: Egypt gam panin Israyl mite a honhon-in paikhiatpih in, a cih Aaron leh Mosheh-te mah ahi hi.
Amaute pen Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh kiangah Egypt gam panin Israyl mite a paikhiatpih nadingun a gente ahi uh hi. Hihte pen Mosheh leh Aaron mah ahi hi.
Egypt gam ah Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah thu a gen ni-in hih bang hong piang a,
tua inah Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah thu genin, a gen inah: Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi. Nang kong gen khempeuh Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh kiangah gen in, cih ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “En in, kei pau-awkpi-a thugen ka hihna tawh Pharaoh in bangci bangin ka thugen hong ngai ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “En in, Pharaoh tungah vanglian khatin nang kong bawlkhin a, na sanggampa Aaron pen na kamsangpa hi ding hi.
Keimah in nang kong thupiak khempeuh a gen ding na hi hi; Pharaoh kiangah ama gam panin Israyl mite a paikhiatsak hamtang nadingin na sanggampa Aaron in a gen ding ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Keimah in Pharaoh’ lungtang ka khauhsak ding hi. Egypt gam sungah Ka limte Ka na lamdangte Ka bawl hangin,

Pharoah in note’ thu hong ngai lo ding hi. Tua ciangin Keimah in Egypt tungah Ka khut ka nga dinga, vanglian thukhen nasepnate tawh Egypt gam sung panin Ka galkapte leh Ka mi Israylte Ka lakhia ding hi.
Keimah in Egypt langdo-in Ka khut ka zankhia-a amaute lak panin Israyl mite Ka paikhiatpih ciangin Egypt mite in Keimah Yahweh Ka hihna thei ding uh hi.
Yahweh in amaute thu a piak bang teekteekin Mosheh leh Aaron in a sem uh hi; hih bangin amaute gamta uh hi.
Amaute in Pharaoh kiangah thu a gen lai-un Mosheh kum 80 pha a, Aaron pen kum 83 a pha hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah thu gen a, a gen inah:

“Pharaoh in note kiangah thu hong genin: ‘Kei aa dingin na lamdang hong bawl un’ a cih ciangin; nangmah in Aaron kiangah: ‘gul khat a suah nadingin na ciangkhut la inla, Pharaoh mai-ah lawnsuk in,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Pharaoh kiangah Mosheh leh Aaron pai uh a, Yahweh in amaute thu a piak bang teekteekin a hih uh hi; Pharaoh leh ama uliante mai-ah Aaron in a ciangkhut lawnsukin gul khat a suak hi.
Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Egypt gam sunga mipilte, aisan siamte leh mitphial siamte samsak a, amau’ thusim siamna tawh tua bang teekteek mahin ahih thei uh hi:
Mitphial siam peuhmah in a ciangkhut uh lawnsuk uh a, gul vive a suak hi. Ahih hangin Aaron’ ciangkhut in amau’ ciangkhutte a nawmvalh hi.
Yahweh in a gensa mah bangin Pharaoh’ lungtang khauh lai veve a, amah in amaute’ thu a ngai kei hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Pharaoh’ lungtang pen khauh a, kingah zo vet lo hi; amah in mipite paisak ding a nial hi.
Amah tui kiangah a paikhiat ciangin zingsangin Pharaoh kiangah pai in. Amah tawh a kimu dingin gun gei-ah ngak inla gul khat a suak na ciangkhut pen na khutin tawi in.

Tua ciangin ama tungah, ‘Yahweh, Hebrew mite Vanglian Pa in nang kiangah keimah hong sawlin, ‘Keimah hong biak theih nadingin Ka mite paisak in; ahih hangin tu ciang dong nangmah in a thu na mang kei hi.’
Yahweh in gen thuah lai a, ‘Hih tawh Keimah Yahweh ka hihna na thei ding hi: ‘Ka khuta om ciangkhut tawh Nile gun tui ka sat ding a, tua pen sisan a suak ding hi.
Gun sunga ngasa si ding a, gun pen uihgawp-in Egypt mite in tua guntui a dawn thei nawn kei uh hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Aaron kiangah gen in: ‘na ciangkhut la inla, Egypt gama tuite tung—amau’ luite tung, amau’ gunte tung, amau’ bualte tung, leh amau’ tuikholnate khempeuh tungah na khut zan in. Tua ciangin tuate sisan a suak ding hi. Egypt gam sung khempeuh ah sing beel suang beel leh tui beelte sung nangawn ah sisan om ding hi,’ci in,” a ci hi.

Mosheh leh Aaron in Yahweh’ gensa bangin a hih uh hi. Tua ahih manin Pharaoh leh ama uliante’ muhna ah Aaron in a ciangkhut laamto-in Nile gun tuite satsuk a, gun sunga tuite khempeuh sisan a suak hi.
Gunsung ngasa si a, gun pen uihgawp-in, Egypt mite in tua guntui dawn thei lo uh hi. Egypt gam sung khempeuh ah sisan a om hi.
Ahih hangin Egypt mitphial siamte amau’ thusim siamnate tawh tua mah bangin a hih thei uh hi; Yahweh genkhitsa mah bangin Pharaoh lungtang khauh a, amah in amaute’ thu a mang kei hi.
Pharaoh kihei-in ama kumpi’ inn sungah a lut a, hih thu hangin a lungsim kihei tuan lo hi.
Tua ahih manin Egypt mite in a dawn ding uh tui a ngah theih nadingin Nile gun kiim a to uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in gun sunga tui a dawn thei kei uh hi.
Yahweh in gun a sat zawh ni sagih a bei ta hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Pharaoh kiangah pai inla ama tungah, “Yahweh in hi bangin ci hi: ‘Amaute in Kei hong biak theih nadingin Ka mite paisak in.
Ahih hangin amaute’ pai ding na nial leh, tua ciangin Keimah in na gam khempeuh ukengte tawh ka gimsak ding hi.

Nile gun in a kahto dingin ukengte hong paikhiasak ding a, na inn sungah, na lupna inndei sungah, na lupna tungah, na uliante inn sungah, na mipite tungah, na meikhukte leh na annel mekna kuang sung uh ah hong pai ding uh hi.
Ukengte nang’ tung, na mipite’ tung leh na uliante khempeuh’ tungah hong kah ding hi,’ ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Aaron gen in: ‘Luite’ tung, tuilaknate’ tung leh bualte’ tungah na ciangkhut tawi-in na khut zankhia inla, Egypt leitang’ tungah ukengte a paikhia dingin bawl in,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Aaron in Egypt gam-a tuite’ tungah a khut zankhia a, ukengte hong paikhia-in Egypt gam a tuam hi.
Ahih hangin mitphial siamte in amaute thusim siamna tawh tua mah bangin hih thei uh a, Egypt leitang tungah ukengte a omsak uh hi.

Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Mosheh leh Aaron samsakin a gen inah, “Yahweh in kei leh ka mite kiang panin ukengte a paikhiatsak nadingin Ama tungah thungen unla keimah in mite Yahweh tungah biakpiakna a pia dingin ka paisak ding hi,” a ci hi.

Mosheh in Pharaoh kiangah, “Nile gun sung bek ah ukengte om lai-in nangmah leh na innte kiang panin amaute a bei nading nang, na uliante leh na mite aa dingin thungetna kong neihsak theih nadingin kei aa dingin a thupi hun sehna pen nang thuneihna-in ka koih hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Pharaoh in, “Zingciang,” a ci hi. Mosheh in, “Yahweh ahi note Pa tawh a kibang khat zong a om hi, cih na theih nadingin, na gen bangbang hi tahen.
Nangma kiang pan, na innte pan, na uliante kiang pan, na mite kiang panin ukengte paikhia mang ding a, Nile gun sung bek ah omlai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Pharaoh’ kiang panin Mosheh leh Aaron paikhia uh a, Yahweh in Pharaoh’ tungah a tunsak ukengte tawh kisai-in Mosheh Ama tungah a kiko hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Mosheh nget bangin hih a, innte, huangte, leh lote panin ukengte a si uh hi;
Amaute in a lomlomin tuate khawm uh a, gam sung teng a uih hi.
Ahih hangin Pharaoh in nopna a omkik lam a muh ciangin, amah in a lungsim khauhsak a, Yahweh’ gensa mah bangin amaute’ thu a ngai kei hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Aaron kiangah gen in: ‘Na ciangkhut zankhia inla, leilak leivui satsuk in; tua pen Egypt gambup ah cippisuak ding hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.

Yahweh’ gen mah bangin amaute in hih uh a, Aaron in a khut tawh a ciangkhut zankhia-in leitung leivui satsuk a, mihing tung leh ganhing tungah cippihong om hi. Egypt gambup-a leilak leivui khempeuh cippia suak mang hi.
Ahih hangin mitphial siamte in amaute siamna tawh cippia piansak ding a hanciam uh hangin amaute in a hih thei kei uh hi. Tua ahih manin mihing tung leh ganhing tungah thokangte a om hi.
Tua ciangin mitphial siamte in Pharaoh kiangah, “Hih pen Yahweh’ sep hi,” a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Pharaoh’ lungtang khauh a, Yahweh’ gensa mah bangin amaute’ thu ngai lo hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Zingsangin thobaih inla, Pharaoh paina tui kiangah amah ngak inla, ama kiangah, ‘Yahweh genna hi bang ahi hi: ‘Amaute in Kei hong biak theih nadingun Ka mite paisak in.
Ahih hangin Ka mite na paisak kei leh, Keimah in nang leh na uliante tung, na mite’ tung leh na innte ah thopi Ka sawl ding hi. Egypt mite innte leh leilak zong thopite tawh kidim ding hi.
Ahih hangin tua ni ciangin Kei pen Yahweh ka hihna na theih nadingin Ka mite omna Goshen gam pen humcipin ka tuam khen ding a, tua lai mun ah thopite om lo ding hi.
Keimah in Ka mite leh na mite kikal ah a deidanna khat ka bawl ding a, hotkhiatna ka pia ding hi. Zingciangin hih limte hong piang ding hi,’ci hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in tua bangin a hih hi. Pharaoh’ kumpi inn sung leh ama uliante innte sungah tho honpite a lomlomin a kia suk hi; tho honpite hangin Egypt gam sung khempeuh leitang kisia hi.
Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Mosheh leh Aaron samsak a, a gen inah, “Pai un, hih gam sungah Yahweh tungah biakpiakna pia un,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Mosheh in, “Tua pen a manin gamtatna hilo hi. Ka Pa Yahweh ka piak uh biakpiakna pen Egypt mite tungah a huathuai; a kihhuai, hi kha ding hi. Tua bangin amaute muhna ah a huathuai; a kihhuai, biakpiakna kote in pia le ung, amaute in kote suang tawh hong deng lo ding ahi uh hiam?
Ni thum paina gamlak ah kote ka pai ding uh a, Amah in kote hong thupiaksa bangin kote Pa Yahweh tungah biakpiakna ka pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Pharaoh in, “Gamlak ah Yahweh na Pa uh na biak theih nadingun keimah in note kong paisak ding hi. Gamlapi ah pai peuhmah kei unla, kei aa dingin thu hong ngetsak un,” a ci hi.

Mosheh in dawng a, “Ka paikhiat phetin Yahweh tungah thu ka ngen ding a, zingciangin thopite in Pharaoh, ama uliante leh a mite nusia ding hi. Ahi zongin Yahweh tungah biakpiakna pia dingin mite paisak lohna tawh Pharaoh aw hong khembawlkik nawn peuhmah kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Pharaoh kiang panin Mosheh paikhia a, Yahweh tungah thu a ngen hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh ngetna bangin hih a, Amah in Pharaoh kiang pan, ama uliante kiang pan leh a mite kiang panin thopite a hemkhia hi. Khat zong om nawn lo hi.
2 Ahih hangin Pharaoh in tutungin zong a lungsim khauhsak a, mite paisak nuam lo hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Pharaoh kiangah lut inla, ama kiangah, ‘Hebrew mite Vanglian Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Amaute in Kei hong biak theih nadingun, Ka mite paisak in.
Nangmah in amaute paisak ding na nial a, amaute na let lai leh,
lo sunga na ganhonte ahi: na sakolte, na laate, na kalaohte, na bawngte, na tuute leh na keelte’ tungah Yahweh’ khut in a mulkim huai pulpi tungsak ding hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl’ ganhon leh Egypt’ ganhon kikal ah a kilamdanna khat Yahweh in bawl ding a, Israyl mite neihsa khempeuh khat zong si lo ding hi,’ ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in hun khat seh a, a gen inah: “Zingciangin Yahweh in hih gam sungah hih na hong sem ding hi,” a ci hi.
A zingciangin Yahweh in hih na sem a, Egypt mite’ ganhon khempeuh si hi; ahih hangin Israyl mite’ ganhon khat zong si lo hi.

Tua ciangin Pharaoh in a sittel dingin mi sawl a, Israyl mite ganhingte khat nangawn zong a sih loh lam a mu hi. Ahih hangin ama lungtang pen khauh-in kingah zo vet lo a, ama muhna panin paikhiasak nuam lo hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah, “Meikhuk panin innking khut dim khat la unla, Pharaoh muhin huih lak ah Mosheh in lawn hen.
Tuate , Egypt gam khempeuh ah leivui neel suak ding a, Egypt gam sung khempeuh ah mihing leh ganhing’ tungah a dam thei lo meimatum a suak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in meikhuk panin innkingte la-in Pharaoh mai-ah Mosheh in innkingte huihlak ah lawn a, tuate in mihing leh ganhing’ tungah meimatum naitawm a piangsak hi.
Mitphial siamte in meimatum veina hangin Mosheh demzo nawn lo uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh mitphial siamte leh Egypt mite khempeuh in meimatum vei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Pharaoh’ lungtang khauhsak a, Yahweh in Mosheh tungah a genkhitsa mah bangin amah in amaute’ thu a ngai kei hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Zingsangin thobaih inla, Pharaoh mai-ah dingin ama kiangah, ‘Hebrew mite Vanglian Yahweh in Hih bangin ci hi: ‘Amaute in Kei hong biak theih nadingun, Ka mite paisak in.
Tutungin tua bangin na hih kei leh, leitung khempeuh ah Kei tawh a kibang khat beek a om lohna na theih nadingin nang, na uliante leh na mite tungah gawtna khauh pen ka tungsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tu-in keimah in ka khut zanin pulnatna tawh nang leh na mite hong vatgawpin, leitung panin note hong kibeisak thei hi.
Ahih hangin Ka vangliatna kong lah theih nading leh leitung khempeuh ah Ka Min a kitangko theih nadingin hih thu hangin nang hong lamsangin kong nuntasak lai hi.
Tua hi na pi-in Ka mite tungah nang kiliansak lai-in amaute na paisak kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingciang tubang hun-in Egypt gam a kisat a kipanin tuhun dongin tua bang a kimu ngei lo, a tam mahmah gialpi ka kiasak ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mi sawl inla, na ganhingte leh gamlak a na neihte khempeuh a muanhuai bukna ah koih in. Bang hang hiam cihleh inn ah a kipaipih lo, gamlak-a om mihing leh ganhing tungah gialpi kia ding a, amaute si ding uh hi,’ ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Pharaoh’ uliante lak panin Yahweh’ kammal a kihta-te in a nasemte leh a ganhingte inn ah taisak hi;
Ahih hangin Yahweh’ kammal a thusim lote in lo sungah a nasemte leh a ganhingte a nusia hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Egypt gam sung khempeuh-a mihing leh ganhing leh gamlak kungte khempeuh tungah gialpi a kiat theih nadingin vantung lamah na khut zan in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in a ciangkhut vanlam ah zankhia-in, Yahweh in vanging leh gialpi sawl a leitungah khua a phiasuk hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Egypt gam tungah gialpi zusak hi.
Gialpi kia-in gial tawh kithuahin khua a phia ziahziah hi. Egypt gam minam khat a suah khit a kipanin Egypt gam khempeuh ah a nasia penpen huihpi ahi hi.
Gialpi in Egypt gam sunga mihingte leh ganhingte, lo-te sunga na khempeuh deng gawp a, lo sunga a po khempeuh dengzan gawpin singkung khempeuh a dengtan hi.
Israyl mite omna Goshen leitang bek ah gial a kia kei hi.
Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Mosheh leh Aaron samsakin amaute kiangah, “Tutungin keimah ka mawh hi. Yahweh a man hi a, ka mite leh kei pen a khial ka hi uh hi.
Vanging lianpi leh gialpi a om nawn loh nadingin Yahweh tungah thungen un. Bang hang hiam cihleh a kicing khinzo hi. Keimah in note kong paisak ding a, note na khawl nawn kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Mosheh in Pharaoh kiangah, “Khuapi sung panin ka paikhiat khit phetin Yahweh tungah thungenin ka khutte ka zankhia ding a, leitung pen Yahweh aa ahih lam na theih nadingin van ging nawn loin gialpi zong om nawn lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah leh na uliante in kote Vantung Pa, Yahweh na kihtak nai loh lam uh ka thei hi.
Anthul a paak laitak hi a, mangbuh-ham a vuih laitak ahih manin anthul leh mangbuh-ham a kisia hi.
Ahih hangin mangbuh leh buh khang nai loin a nung ciangin kila pan ding ahih manin a kisia kei hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh khuapi sung Pharaoh kiang panin paikhia a, Yahweh tungah thungenin a khutte zankhia hi; tua tak ciangin vanging leh gialpi dai a, leitunga a zuziahziah guah zong a theu ta hi.
Pharaoh in guah, gialpi leh vangingte khawlkhin cih a muh ciangin amah khial beh lai a, amah leh ama uliante in a lungsim uh a khauhsak uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh tungtawnin Yahweh in a genkhitsa mah bangin Pharaoh’ lungtang pen khauh a, amah in Israyl mite pai ding a phal kei hi.

1-2Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Pharaoh kiangah pai in. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute lak ah hih a piandang ka limte ka bawlbawl thei nadingin, na tu na tate uh tungah Egypt mite ka gimbawlzia leh amaute laka limte ka bawlzia leh Keimah Yahweh ka hih lam na theih nadingun amah leh a uliante lungtang ka khuahsak hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Pharaoh kiangah Mosheh leh Aaron pai a, ama kiangah, “Hebrew mite’ Pa, Yahweh thugen hih bang ahi hi: ‘Ka mai-ah nang na kiniamkhiat nading bang tanvei nial ding na hi hiam? Amaute in Kei hong biak theih nadingun Ka mite paisak in.
Tua bang ahih kei a, Ka mite na paisak ding na nial leh, zingciangin na gam sungah kauphete kong paipih ding hi;
Tuate in a kimu thei lo zahin lei maitang tuam ding uh hi. Tuate in na lo sung uh uha a po peuhmah singkungte a kipan gialpi den bang a themte ne mang ding uh hi.

Na pate ahi a, na pa’ pate ahi zongin hih gam ah a ten uh a kipan tuni donga tua bang a muh ngei lohte, na innte, na uliante’ innte khempeuh, leh Egypt mite innte khempeuh ah dim ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Mosheh kihei-in Pharaoh kiang panin a paikhia hi.

Pharaoh’ uliante in ama kiangah, “Eite tungah hih mipa bang tanvei thangzak hong hi niloh ding ahi hiam? Amaute in a Vantung Pa, Yahweh a biak theih nadingin hih mite paisak in. Egypt a siatna theitel nai lo na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh leh Aaron pen Pharaoh kiangah kipaipihkik a, Pharaoh in amaute kiangah, “Pai un! Yahweh’ na va sem un! Ahi zongin a pai ding kua teng ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in dawng a, “Yahweh tungah pawi khat ka kham ding ka hih manun a moi a ham ka tanu ka tapate uh ka tuuhon ka bawng honte uh tawh ka pai ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Pharaoh in amaute kiangah, “Note leh note’ lak panin a neu pente dong hong paisak taak leh Yahweh in note hong ompih ta hen! Ngimna hoih lo na nei uh a, na neihsa khempeuh uh tawh Egypt taisan ding na sawmna uh pen note maitang uh ah kilang mahmah hi! Tua pen kilang mahmah hi.
Hilo hi! Tu tanvei nong nget buangun pasal teng bek pai unla Yahweh va bia un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Pharaoh’ omna panin Mosheh leh Aaron kihawlkhia hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Leitang tungah kauphete dimin, gialpi in a den baang kunghing khempeuh lo sunga a po khempeuh ne tum dingin Egypt gam tungah na khut zankhia in.

Tua ahih manin Mosheh in Egypt gam tungah a ciangkhut zankhia a, tua ciangin Yahweh in tua sun tawntung leh tua zan tawntung leitang tungah nisuahna’ huih a nungsak hi. Zingsang ciangin tua huih in kauphete hong tunkhin hi.
Amaute in Egypt gam khempeuh ah hong lutin hong sim a, gam sung mun tuamtuam ah tampitak a om hi. Cikmah-a a piang ngei lo, zong a piangkik nawn lo ding kauphe’ gimna ahi hi.

Kauphete in leitang khempeuh tuamcipin vom liang hi. Lo sunga a po peuhmah, leh singkungte tunga a gah khempeuh, gialpi dengawp baang khempeuh amaute in a netum uh hi. Egypt gambup ah singkung hitaleh ankung hitaleh a hing khat zong om nawn lo hi.
Tua ciangin Pharaoh in manlang takin Mosheh leh Aaron samsak a, “Na Pa uh Yahweh tung leh note tungah ka mawh khin hi.
Tu-in tua ahih manin, hehpihna-in tu-a khatvei bek ka mawhna hong maisak inla, hih sihna pan bekbekin Amah in kei hong lakkhiat nadingin Yahweh na Pa tungah thungen in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Pharaoh kiang panin Mosheh paikhia-in Yahweh tungah thungenin a thum ngetngut hi.
Yahweh in a khauh mahmah nitumna lam huihpi nungsak a, tua in kauphete muut-in Tuipi San sung a denna hi. Egypt gam sungah kauphe khat zong om nawn lo hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Pharaoh’ lungtang khauhsak a, amah in Israyl mite a paisak kei hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “A kilawng thei zaha Egypt gam ah khuamial a om nadingin van lamah na khut zankhia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in van lamah a khut zankhia a, Egypt gam khempeuh ah ni thum sung khuamial bikbek hi.
Ni thum sung kuamah in bangmah mu thei lo uh a, ama omna panin kuamah a paikhia thei kei hi. Ahih hangin Israyl mite khempeuh in a tenna munte ah khuavak a nei uh hi.

Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Mosheh samsak a, “Pai un, Yahweh’ na sem un! Na numeite uh leh na naupangte uh nangawn zong na tonpih thei uh hi; na tuuhonte leh na bawnghonte bek uh na omsak lai ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Mosheh in, “Yahweh tungah biakpiakna a nei ding leh meihal biakna a pia dingin kote nong phal loh phamawh hi.

Ka ganhonte uh zong ko tawh hong paikul hi; gan khecin khat nangawn zong nusiat ding hilo hi. Ka Pa uh Yahweh biakna-in amaute lak pan pawlkhat zatloh phamawh a, tua lai mun ka tun matengun Yahweh biakna ah koite zat ding hiam cih kote in ka thei kei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Pharaoh’ lungtang khauhsak a, amah in amaute paisak nuam lo hi.
Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Mosheh kiangah, “Ka kiang panin taikhia in! Ka mai-ah nong kilakkik lohna dingin kidawm in! Bang hang hiam cihleh ka mai na muh ni-in na si ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in, “Nangmah in thuman takin na genkhin hi; Na mai ka mukik ngei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tu-in Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Pharaoh tung leh Egypt’ tungah Keimah in gimna khat Ka puak lai ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in hih mun panin note hong paisak ding hi. Amah in note hong paisak ciangin, amah in hih mun panin note hong hawlkhia siang ding hi.
Pasalte leh numeite in a vengte kiangah ngun leh kham ahi vante a nget nadingin mipite gen in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Egypt mite’ muhna ah mite maipha pia hi. Tua tham loin mipa Mosheh pen Egypt gam sungah Pharaoh’ uliante leh mite in a pi muh mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in, “Yahweh genna hih bang ahi hi: ‘Zankim pawlin Egypt gam Ka siksuak ding hi;
Kumpi tokhom tunga tu Pharaoh’ tacil a kipanin an gawi-a a om nasem numei tacil dong leh ganhing tacil khempeuh nangawn, Egypt gam sunga tacil khempeuh si ding hi.
Tua ciangin nidangin tua bang a om ngei lo, zong a omkik ngei nawn lo ding kahna lianpi Egypt leitang tung khempeuh ah om ding hi.

Ahih hangin Israyl mite lakah mihing ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin ui khat nangawnin na lo ding hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in Egypt leh Israyl kikal ah kilamdanna khat leh hotkhiatna khat a bawl lam note in na thei ding uh hi,’ ci hi.

Hih na uliante khempeuh ka kiangah hong pai ding uh a, ka mai-ah kunsukin, ‘Pai in! nang leh nang hong zui na mite khempeuh paikhia un!’ hong ci ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin kei ka paikhia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Pharaoh kiang panin Mosheh heh mahmah sa-in a paikhia hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Egypt gam sungah Ka na lamdangte a tamzaw a kibawl theih nadingin Pharaoh in na thu ngai lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Pharaoh mai-ah Mosheh leh Aaron in hih na lamdangte khempeuh bawl hi; Yahweh in Pharaoh’ lungtang khauhsak a, amah in ama gam panin Israyl mite a paikhiasak kei hi.
Yahweh in Egypt gam sung Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah:
“Tu Kha pen note aa dingin Kha kipatna hi ding a, Kum khat sunga a Kha Masa hi ding hi.
Israyl mihon khempeuh kiangah, “Hih Kha Masa, a ni Sawm Ni-in mikim in ama innkuan aa dingin tuuno khat la ding a, innkuan khat ciat aa dingin tuuno khat ta hi ding hi.
Tuuno khat aa dingin innkuan a tawmluat leh amau innzom a sanggampa tawh, a mi tawh kituakin a sa hawm ding uh hi. Mi khat ciat nek ding a kisamzah tawh kituakin tuuno na teel ding ahi hi.
Na tuuno uh a sitbaang lo; a melhem lo, kum khat a pha a pa hi hamtang ding hi. Tua pen tuu pan ahi a keel pan ahi zongin na la thei ding uh hi.
Tua Kha a ni Sawm le li Ni dong tua ganno pen na kem hamtang ding uh hi: tua khit ciangin Israyl mihonte khempeuh in tua nitak nihte kikal ah tua ganno a go ding uh hi.
Amaute in a si pawlkhat la-in tuuno sa a nekna uh innte’ kongmungte a tung leh a pang tuak ah a tat ding uh hi.
Tua zanin amaute in a sa mei ah hang minin, silngo sawh loh anlum leh lokha; a kha mehteh, tawh amaute in ne ding uh hi.
A sa a sial ahi a, tui huanin ahi zongin ne loin, a lu leh a khete leh a sungkuate tawh hangminin na ne ding uh hi.
Zingsang dong khamval bangmah na omsak kei ding uh hi; ahih hangin zingsang dong a om lai peuhmah na hal tum hamtang ding uh hi.
Tua pen hih bangin na ne ding uh hi: Na kawng uh gaksa, khedap bulhsa, na khut uh ah na ciangkhut uh tawi kawmsa-in na nawh nek ding uh hi; Hih pen Yahweh’ Paisanna hi hi;

bang hang hiam cihleh tu zan ciangin Egypt gam Ka nawksuak ding a, mihing leh ganhing’ tacil khempeuh Ka satlum ding hi; Egypt’ pasiante (elohim) tungah thukhenna Ka tungsak ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh Ka hi hi.

Note omna inn tunga sisan pen note aa dingin ciaptehna lim khat ahi hi. Tua sisan ka muh ciangin note kong paisan ding hi; Egypt gam Ka vatgawp ciangin note hong susia ding gimna note’ tungah hong tung lo ding hi.

Hih ni pen note tungah phawk tawntungna khat hi ding hi; hih pen note in na khang tawntungun Yahweh tungah Pawi khatin na nei ding uh hi. Note in a kip tawntung biakna ngeina kip Pawi khatin na nei ding uh hi.

Ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi. Tua ni-in na innte uh panin silngo na lakhia ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a ni masa ni panin a ni sagih ni dong silngo sawh anlum a ne mi peuhmah Israyl mi panin khenkhia ding hi.

A ni masa ni-in a Siangtho kikhopna khat; khawmpi siangtho khat, om ding a, a ni sagih ni-in note aa dingin a siangtho kikhopna khat; khawmpi siangtho khat, a om ding hi. Tua nite ah note nek ding bawlin na sepna bek uh cih simloh na dang na sem kei ding uh hi.

Note in Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih ni teekteekin Egypt gam panin na mihonte uh Ka paikhiatpih hi. Tua ahih ciangin na khang tawntungun hih ni pen biakna ngeina kip khatin na nei tawntung ding uh hi.
Kha Masa sung tua kha a ni sawm le li ni nitak panin tua kha a ni sawm nih le khat ni nitak dong silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi.
Ni sagih sung na inn sungte ah silngo kimu lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh silngo ahi na khatpeuh a ne mi pen tualsuak ahi a, peemta ahi zongin Israyl mihonte sung panin kikhenkhia ding hi.
Silngo kisawh peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi. Na tenna khempeuh uh ah silngo sawh loh anlum na ne pelmawh ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in Israyl upate khempeuh samsak a, amaute kiangah, “Hong paikhia unla, note innkuan tawh a kituakin tuuno khat teelin la unla, Paisan tuuno go un.
Puknah lomkhat la unla, kuang sunga om sisan sungah diahin, si pawlkhat pen kongkhakmung tung leh a pang tuak ah zut un; zingsang mateng na inn kongkhak panun khat zong na pusuakkhia kei ding uh hi;

bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt mite a vatgawp dingin Yahweh in hong nawk ding hi; Amah in kongkhakmung tung leh a pang tuaka sisan a muh ciangin, Yahweh in tua kongkhak lampi Paisan ding a, Asusiate na inn ah a lut ding leh note hong vatgawp ding phal lo ding hi.
Note leh na tapate un hih pen biakna ngeina kipin na nei tawntung ding uh hi.
Yahweh in piak dingin hong ciamsa tua leitang ah na lut uh ciangin hih ngeina na zui ding uh hi.
Na tate un ‘Hih bangin hihna pen bang a deihna ahi hiam?’ ci-in hong dot ciangin,

note in amaute kiangah, ‘Hih pen Egypt gam sunga Israyl mite’ innte a paisan, Egypt mite Amah in a vatgawp lai-in i innte hong hawisakpa, Yahweh tungah Paisan Biakpiakna ahi hi,’ na ci ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin mite a lukunin a bia uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl mite a paimang uh a, Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron a thupiak khitsa bangin amaute a gamta uh hi.

Zankimin hici bangin hong piang hi; kumpi tokhom tunga a tu Pharaoh’ tacil-a kipan thongmial sunga a om a kiman mite’ tacil leh ganhing tacil khempeuh, Egypt gam sunga tacil khempeuh Yahweh in a vatgawp hi.
Pharaoh leh ama uliante khempeuh, leh Egypt mite khempeuh zan laitakin tho uh a, Egypt gam sungah nakpi takin kahna a om hi; bang hang hiam cihleh khat beek a sih lohna inn khat zong a om kei hi.
Amah in a zan a zanin Mosheh leh Aaron samsakin a gen inah, “Tho un! Ka mite kiang panin note leh Israyl mite paikhia un. Pai un! Na gensa bangun Yahweh’ na sem un.
Na gensa bangun na tuuhonte uh leh na ganhonte uh zong hawl unla pai un! Kei zong thupha hong pia un,” a ci hi.
Tua gam sung panin amaute a paikhiat thei nadingin Egypt mite in mite a nawhsawl mahmah uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in, ‘Eite khempeuh i si ding hi,’ a ci uh hi.
Mipite in a annel mekmansa uh silngo sawh ma-in la uh a, a mekna kuang sungah puan khuhin, a liangko uh ah a pua uh hi.
Mosheh in a hilhsa bangin Israyl mite in a sem uh hi. Amaute in Egypt mite tung pan ngun leh kham-a kibawl vante, leh puansilh a ngen uh hi.
Egypt mite muhna ah Yahweh in mite maipha pia a, amaute’ nget peuhpeuh a pia uh hi. Hih bang danin amaute in Egypt mite’ na a sut uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Israyl mite, Rameses pan Succoth ah a zin uh hi. Numei leh naupang simloh pasal khe-a pai 600,000 bang (tul zaguk) a pha hi.
A kihelzau mihon khat zong amaute tawh paito uh a; tuuhonte, bawnghonte leh ganhonte tampi tawh zong ahi hi.

Egypt gam panin a puak uh annel lom tawh amaute in silngo kisawh lo moh a em uh hi; silngo kisawh lohna ahang in Egypt gam panin amaute kihawlkhia a, ze-ol tat thei lo-in amaute’ annek ding zong kiging man lo uh hi.
Tu-in Israyl mite leh amau’ pate Canaan gam sung leh Egypt gam sung a om sung uh pen kum 430 ahi hi.
Kum 430 a cin ni teekteekin hi bangin hi a, Egypt leitang panin Yahweh’ mihonpite khempeuh a paikhia uh hi.
Egypt gam panin amaute kipaikhiatpih ahih manin Yahweh tungah vil gige ding zan khat ahi hi; hih pen Israyl mi khempeuh in a khang a khangin a vil gige ding uh Yahweh’ zan ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah, “Hih pen Paisan ngeina kip ahi hi: Khualmi khatpeuh in nek ding hilo hi.
Ahih hangin sum tawh a kilei sila peuhmah pen a vun na at khit uh ciangin ne thei pan ding hi.
Ahi zongin khualzin-a hong taamte leh sum thalawh-a omte in a ne thei kei ding uh hi.
Tua pen inn khat sungah kine ding a; inn pualam ah a sa kipaikhiatpih lo ding hi; A guhte khat zong na kitansak kei ding uh hi.
Israyl mihon khempeuh in tua pen a bawl ding uh hi.

Note lakah khualmi khatpeuh hong tengin Yahweh tungah Paisan biakpiakna a bawl nop leh, a pasal khempeuh’ vun atsak un; tua ciangin amah a nai-ah hong pai-in bawl thei ding a, amah pen tualsuak khat bang ahi ding hi. Ahih hangin vun ki-at lo mi peuhmah in ne lo ding hi.
Tualsuak mi aa ding leh note laka hong teng khualmi aa dingin Thukham Khat bek om ding hi.
Tua bangin Israyl mi khempeuh gamta uh hi; Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron a thupiaksa bangin amaute in a hih uh hi.
Tua ni teekteekin hici bang hong piang hi; Yahweh in Israyl mite a pawlpawlin Egypt gam pan a paikhiatpih hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Keima tungah tacil apa peuhmah hong ap in. Israyl mite lakah mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh naubu a hong masa pen peuhmah Kei tawh kisai a, Kei aa ahi hi.
Mosheh in mite kiangah, “Salsuahna Egypt gam panin na paikhiat uh hih ni phawk un. Bang hang hiam cihleh a thahat khut tawh Yahweh in tua panin hong paikhiatpih hi. Silgo sawh anlum kine lo ding a,
Barley buh vui Kha, Abib Kha tuni-in a paikhia na hi uh hi.

Hih bang hong hi ding hi; Amah in note tungah piak dinga na pate’ tungah a ciam, bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna leitang, Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Hiv mite leh Yebus mite’ leitang ah Yahweh in note hong paipih ciangin hih kha sungin hih bangin na hih ding uh hi.
Ni sagih sung note in silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh a, a ni sagih ni-in Yahweh aa ding pawl na bawl ding uh hi.
Silngo sawh loh anlum ni sagih sung kine ding hi; note lakah silngo khat zong kimu lo ding a, na huang sung khempeuh ah zong silngo kimu lo ding hi.
Tua ni-in na tapa kiangah, ‘Hih pen Egypt gam panin ka paikhiat lai-in Yahweh in kei aa dingin hong hihsakna hang ahi hi,’ na ci ding uh hi.

Na kam sungah Yahweh’ Thukham a om theih nadingin note’ khut tungah ciaptehna lim khat leh na mitte kikal ah phawk tawntungna khat a hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a thahat khut khat tawh Egypt gam panin hong pikhiakhin hi.
Tua ahih manin kum khat pan kum khat a kiseh hunin hih biakna ngeina kip na zui ding uh hi.
Hih bangin hong hi ding hi; Canaan mite gam sungah Yahweh in note hong paipih ciangin Amah in note leh na pate kiangah a ciamsa bangin note’ tungah tua gam hong pia hi;
naubu a hong khempeuh Yahweh tungah na tuamkoih ding uh a; tua pen, note neih ganhing panin a suakkhia a masa peuhmah, apa khempeuh Yahweh aa ahi hi.
Ahih hangin laa a tacil peuhmah tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding uh hi; na tat kei ding uh leh a ngawng na kuaitan ding uh hi. Na tapate laka tacil khempeuh na tanh ding uh hi.
Mailam hun ah na tapa in, ‘Hih pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?’ ci-in hong dot ciangin ama kiangah, ‘Egypt-a salsuahna panin Yahweh in a thahat khut tawh kote hong paikhiatpih hi;

Pharaoh in kote paisak ding a nial tentan ciangin Egypt gam sunga mihing tacil leh ganhing tacil khempeuh Yahweh in that hi. Hih thu hangin Keimah in Yahweh tungah naubu khempeuh-a piangkhia masa pasal peuhmah biakna-in ka pia uh a, ka tapa a piang masa pen khat ciat ka tanh uh hi.
Tua pen na khut tunga om ciaptehna lim bangin, leh na mitte’ kikal-a talsuante bang hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh a thahat khut tawh Yahweh in Egypt gam panin eite hong paikhiatpih hi,” a ci hi.

Pharaoh in mite a paisak ciangin Philistines gam lampi a tom zawk hangin Yahweh in amaute tua lampi totpih lo hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in, ‘Amaute in gal tuak kha leh, amaute lungsim kikhel kha dinga, Egypt gam ah kilehkik kha ding hi,’a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Tuipi San lam gamlak lam tawnin a paikhiatpih hi. Egypt gam leitang panin Israyl mite galdo ding kithawisa-in a paito uh hi.

Mosheh in amah tawh Yahseph guhte paipih hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahseph in, ‘Yahweh in note hong honkhia taktak ding a, tua ciangin note in hih lai mun panin ka guhte na puato hamtang ding uh hi,’ ci-in thupi takin kiciamna nuai ah Israyl mite a koih hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute Succoth panin zin uh a, sehnel gam nawl-a Etham ah giahphual a sat uh hi.

Amaute, sun hitaleh zan hitaleh khualzinin a pai theih nadingun sunin amaute lam a lak dingin meii khuam khat tawh, zanin in amaute khuavak a pia dingin mei khuam khat tawh, amaute mai-ah Yahweh a pai hi.
Sunin meii khuam ahi a, zanin mei khuam ahi zongin Amah in mite kiang panin lakhia lo hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopih-in a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiheikikin Migdol leh tuipi kikal, Pi Hahiroth nai-ah giahphual a sat nading gen in. Amaute in tuipi gei Baal Zephon tawh a kimaingat lianin giahphual a sat ding uh ahi hi.
Hih bangin Pharaoh in, ‘Israyl mite buaigawpin sehnel gam sungah tangciakin kawi vakvak uh hi,’ ci-in a ngaihsun ding hi.

Tua ciangin Pharaoh’ lungtang Ka khauhsak ding a, amah in amaute a delh ding hi; Pharaoh’ tung leh ama galkap khempeuh tungah pahtawina Ka ngah ding a, Egypt mite in Keimah Yahweh ka hihna hong thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in tua mah bangin a hih hi.

Mite a tai mangna thu Egypt kumpipa kiangah a kigen ciangin Pharaoh leh a uliante’ lungsim kikhel a, amaute in tua ciangin, “Bang hangin eite hici gamtat mawk i hi hiam? Eite’ na a sepna panin Israyl mite i paisak hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in a leeng kithawisakin, ama galkapte a la hi.
Amah in leeng hoih pen 600 leh Egypt gam-a a dang leengte khempeuh a la hi; tua khempeuh tungah a uliante a tuang hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh’ lungtang khauhsak a, hangsan takin Israyl mite a paikhiat laitak a delh hi;

ahih hangin Egypt mite in a sakolte khempeuh, Pharaoh sakol leeng hawlte’ leengte leh ama galkapte tawh amaute delh a, tuipi nai-a Pi Hahiroth gei, Baal Zephon tawh a kimaingatna giahphual ah amaute a pha uh hi.
Pharaoh hong nai ciangin Israyl mite khuadakto a, en un amaute nungah Egypt mite hong kuankhia damdam uh hi. Israyl mite lau mahmah uh a, Yahweh tungah a kiko uh hi.
Amaute in Mosheh kiangah, “Egypt ah han a om loh manin kote a si dingin gamlakah hong paikhiatpih na hi hiam? Egypt panin nong paikhiatpih kote bang hong suah ta na hi hiam?

Egypt-a i om lai-in, ‘Kote hong hici omsak inla, Egypt mite’ na hong semsak in’ hong ci hilo ka hi uh hiam? Hih gamlak ah sih sangin Egypt mite’ na sep ding kote aa dingin hoihzaw ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Mosheh in mite kiangah, “Lau kei un, ding kip un, tuni-in note aa dingin Amah in hong kicinsak ding Yahweh hotkhiatna mu un; tuni-a na muh uh Egypt mite cikmah hunin na mukik nawn kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh in note aa dingin hong dosak ding a, note na om hithiat lel ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Bang hangin Kei tungah hong kiko na hi hiam? Israyl mite mainawtin a pai ding gen in.
Israyl mite in leikeu tawnin tuipi a kantan theih nadingun tui kikhensak dingin na ciangkhut liikto inla, tuipi tungah na khut zan in.

Keimah in Egypt mite’ lungtangte ka khauhsak taktak ding a, amaute in Israyl mite nungzuih ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Pharaoh leh a galkapte khempeuh, ama leengte, leh ama sakol tung tuangte’ tungah pahtawina ka ngah ding hi.
Pharaoh, ama leengte leh ama sakol tung tuangte’ tungah gualzawhna ka ngah khit ciangin Egypt mite in Keimah Yahweh ka hihna hong thei ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl galkapte mai-a pai Yahweh’ vantungmi nungkikin amaute nungah a pai hi. Amaute’ mai panin meii khuampi zong kikhinin amaute nungah ding a,

Egypt galkapte leh Israyl giahphual kikal ah hong om hi. Zan tawntungin tua meii in a langkhat lam khuamial puak a, adang langkhat lam khuavak a puak hi; tua ahih manin zan tawntungin amaute kineh kha lo uh hi.
Mosheh in tuipi tungah a khut zankhia-in, tua zan tawntung nisuahna huih khauh tawh Yahweh in tuipi lehluansakin, tuipi pen lei keu suaksak a, tuite a kikhen hi.
Israyl mite tuipi laizang lei keu tungah pai uh a, amau taklam leh amau veilam ah tuite pen amaute aa dingin kawm a hong hi ta hi.
Egypt mite, Pharaoh’ sakolte, ama leengte leh ama sakol tung tuangte khempeuh in amaute delh uh a, tuipi laizang amau nungah pai uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin Yahweh in mei leh meii khuam panin Egypt galkapte ensuk a, amaute a buaisak gawp hi:

Amah in amaute leeng peite gumsak gawp ahih manin amaute in haksapi takin a hawl uh hi. Egypt mite in, “Israyl’ mai panin eite taimang ni. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute aa dingin Yahweh in Egypt mite a dosak hi!” a ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Egypt mite tung, amaute leengte tung leh amau sakol tung tuangte tungah tui hong luankik theih nadingin tuipi tungah na khut zankhia in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Mosheh in tuipi tungah a khut zankhia a, zingsang khua a vak ciangin a luan ngei bangin tuipi hong luangkikin tua sungah Egypt mite tai uh hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Egypt mite tuipi laizangah lumlet mang hi.
Tui hong luangkik a, leengte leh sakol tung tuangte, tuipi sungah Israyl mite a delh Pharaoh’ galkap khempeuh a tuum hi. Amaute khat zong a suakta kei hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl mite pen tuipi laizang lei keu tungah a pai uh hi. Amau’ taklam leh amau’ veilam ah amau aa dingin kawm bangin tui a om hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Egypt mite khut panin tua ni-in Israyl mite honkhia a, Israyl mite in tuipi gei ah Egypt mi site mu uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Egypt mite tungah a bawl nasepna lianpi, Israyl mite in a mu uh hi; tua ahih manin mite in Yahweh zahtak mahmah uh a, Yahweh leh Ama nasem Mosheh a um uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh leh Israyl mite in Yahweh tungah hih la sa uh hi: “Yahweh in thupi takin gualzo ahih manin Ama tungah la ka sa ding hi! Amah in sakol leh a tuangpa tuipi sungah a lawn hi!
Yahweh pen ka thahatna leh ka la hi a, Amah ka honkhiatna suakzo hi; Amah pen ka vantung Pa hi a, Amah ka phat ding hi; ka pa’ Pa hi a, Amah ka tawisang ding hi.
Yahweh pen galhang mi hi a, Yahweh pen Ama Min ahi hi.
Amah in Pharaoh’ leengte leh ama galkap honpite, tuipi sungah a lawnsuk hi; ama teltuam uliante zong, Tuipi San sungah a tumsuk hi.
Tuipi thukpi in amau tuum a, suang bangin a taw dongah tumsuk hi.
Yahweh aw, Na taklam khut thupi-in vanglian a, Yahweh aw, Na taklam khut in galte a thehthang hi.
Na thupina liatna sungah, Nang hong langpangte na lawnthal hi; Nangmah in na hehna na khahkhia a, buhtu bangin amaute a kang tum hi.
Na nak vang pana huih thahat tawh tuite kikaikhawm a, suangcian bangin a dingkip hi; tuipi’ lungtang sungah tui thukpite khal hi.
Galte in, ‘ka delh ding a, ka pha ding hi. A nate uh ka hawm ding a, ka deih zahzah-in tuate ka tang ding hi. Ka namsau ka dok ding a, ka khut in amaute susia ding hi,’ a ci uh hi.
Nangmah in na huih tawh na muut a, tuipi in amaute tuum hi; tui khauh sungah amaute haknaw bangin a tumsuk uh hi.
Yahweh aw, pasiante (elohim) lakah nang tawh kua kibang ahi hiam? Sianthona ah thupi-in, phat dingin a kilawm, na lamdang a sem Nang bang kua om ahi hiam?
Nangmah in Na taklam khut na zankhia a, leitang in amaute nawmvalh hi.
Na hehpihna tawh, Na tatsa Na mite na makaih a, Na thahatna tawh a siangtho Na omna ah amaute lam na lak hi.
Mite in za-in lau ding uh a, Philistine-te tenna dahna in mancip ding hi.
Edom ukpite lau mahmah ding uh a, Moab makaite dipkuatna in mancip ding hi; Canaan ukte tuisuak mang ding uh a,
amaute tungah launa leh dipkuatna tung ding hi. Na mite a paisuak mateng, Na leisa mite a paisuak matengin, Yahweh aw, Na ban thahatna tawh amaute suangtum bangin taang loin om ding uh hi.
Nangmah in Israyl mite na paipih ding a, Yahweh aw, Na tenna dinga Na bawlna mun, Yahweh aw Na khutte in a kipsaksa Mun Siangtho, Na omna mual tungah amaute na suan ding hi.
Yahweh in a tawntungin uk ding hi,” a ci hi.

Pharaoh’ sakolte a leengte tawh leh a sakol tung tuangte tawh tuipi sungah a pai ciangin, tuipi tuite amaute tungah a tuumsakkik hi. Ahih hangin Israyl mite pen tuipi laizang lei keu tungah a pai uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Aaron sanggam nu ahi kamsang numei Miriam in a khut sungah khuangno la-in, numei khempeuh in khuangnote leh lamna tawh a zui uh hi.
Miriam in amaute lasak a, “Yahweh in thupi takin gualzo ahih manin Ama tungah la ka sa ding hi! Amah in sakol leh a tuangpa tuipi sungah a lawn hi!” a ci hi. (Pai 15:1)
Tua ciangin Tuipi San panin Mosheh in Israyl mite paipihsuak hi; tua ciangin amaute Shur gamlak ah pai uh hi. Amaute gamlak ah ni thum sung pai uh a, tui mu lo uh hi.
Tu-in amaute Marah a tun uh ciangin, tuikha ahih manin tui a dawn thei kei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua tui min pen Marah a kici hi. A khiatna in Kha a cihna ahi hi.
Mosheh tungah mite phunin a gen inah, “Bang dawn ding i hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahweh tungah Mosheh kiko a, Yahweh in amah singkung khat a lak hi; amah in tui sungah tua sing lawnsuk a, tuite pen tuilim; dawn theih tui, hong suak hi. Tua munah Mosheh tungtawnin Amah in Thukhamte, thukhennate, leh ngeina kipte amaute pia a, tua mun panin amaute ze-et

a gen inah, “Note in na Pa uh Yahweh’ thu limtakin ngaih uh a, ama muhna ah a man nate hihin, a Thukhamte don a, ama ngeina kipte khempeuh na zuih uh leh, Egypt mite tunga ka tunsak natnate khat beek note tungah kong tungsak kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Kei pen Yahweh Ropheka ka hi hi; Yahweh note hong damsakpa ka hi hi.,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin tuikhuk sawm le nihte leh nisuh kung 70 a omna mun Elim ah amaute tung uh a, tui gei tua mun ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elim panin amaute pailai a, Egypt gam panin a paikhiat khit zawh a Kha nihna a ni 15 ni-in Elim leh Sinai kikal, Sin gamlakah Israyl mihonpite khempeuh a tung uh hi.
Gamlak ah Mosheh leh Aaron, Israyl mihon buppi in phun uh a,

Israyl mi honpite in amaute kiangah, “Egypt gam sungah Yahweh’ khut tawh eite a sikhin hi zaw ta hoh leng! Tua munah kote sabeel phungah tu-in ka duh zahzah an khempeuh ka ne uh hi; ahih hangin mihon buppi gilkialna tawh a si dingin kote gamlak ah nong paikhiatpih uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Note aa dingin vantung panin an Ka zusak ding hi. Amaute Ka Thukham sungah kalsuan uh hiam, kalsuan lo uh hiam ci-in a kimuh nading, amaute Ka ze-et theih nadingin mite pusuakin ni simin a khamkhop zah ding uh khawm ding uh hi.
A ni gukna ni-in mite in a khopsate uh bawl ding uh a, nidanga a kaihkhop zah nih a luak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh leh Aaron in Israyl mihon khempeuh kiangah, “Egypt leitang panin Yahweh in note hong paikhiatpihna nitak ciangin na thei ding uh hi;
Zingsang ciangin Yahweh’ minthanna na mu ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Ama tunga na phunnate uh Amah in zakhin hi. Ahih hangin kote tungah nong phun dingun kote kua ka hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.

Mosheh in gen beh lai a, “Yahweh in nitakin na nek ding uh sa, zingsangin na kham takin na nek ding uh an khempeuh hong piak ciangin tua pen Yahweh ahihna na thei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note phunnate pen kote’ tungah hiloin Yahweh’ tungah hi a, Yahweh in za hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in Aaron kiangah, “Israyl mihonpi khempeuh kiangah gen in: ‘Yahweh mai-ah hong pai un; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in note phunnate a zakhin hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Aaron in Israyl mihon buppi kiangah thu a gen laitakin, amaute in gamlak lam en uh a, kalai! Yahweh’ minthanna meii khat sungah kilang hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:

“Israyl mite phunnate Ka zakhin hi. Amaute kiangah gen in, ‘Nitak nihte kikal ah note in sa na ne ding uh a, zingsang ciangin an na kham ding uh hi. Tua ciangin note in Keimah Yahweh note Pa ka hihna na thei ding uh hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Nitak ciangin vamimte hong pai-in giahphual tuam a, zingsang ciangin giahphual kiim-ah daitui kia-in hih bangin hong piang hi.
Daitui a kap ciangin leilak ah vukkhal bangin a pa deldal-te a om hi.

Israyl mite in tua a muh uh ciangin, amaute khatlekhat in, “Manna maw? Bang a le?” a kici uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tua bang hi hiam cih amaute in thei lo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Mosheh in amaute kiangah, “Hih pen Yahweh in nek dingin note hong piak an ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Hih pen Yahweh hong thupiaksa ahi hi: “Khat ciat in ama khamkhop zah ciat a khawm ding hi. Mi khat ciat aa dingin na puanbuk sunga note neih omer; 2.3 litres kiim a ta na tehna, khatta la un,” a ci hi.
Amaute thupiak bangin Israyl mite gamta uh a, pawlkhat in tampi kaikhawmin kimkhat in tawmno bek kaikhawm uh a,
Amaute in omer tawh a teh ciangin tampi a kaikhawm pa in tampi nei tuan loin tawmno a kaikhawm pa aa zong tawmlua tuan lo hi. Khat ciat in amau’ khamkhop zah ciatin a kaikhawm uh hi.

Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Hih pen Yahweh hong thupiaksa bang ahi hi: ‘Zingciang pen tawlngak ni hi a, Yahweh aa dingin a Siangtho Shabbat ni ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuni-in na em dingte uh emin, na huan dingte uh huan unla, a om lai teng zingsang dong koih un,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi.

Ni guk sung note in na kaikhawm ding uh a, ahih hangin a ni Sagihna ni ahi Shabbat ni-in bangmah om lo ding hi.
Tua bang a cih hangin Ni Sagihna ni-in mi kimkhat tua a kaikhawm dingin paikhia uh a, ahih hangin bangmah mu lo uh hi.

En in! Yahweh in note Shabbat hong pia khin a, tua hangin a Ni Gukna ni-in Amah in ni nih ai ding an hong pia hi. Mi khempeuh amau omna ciat ah omsak inla, Ni Sagih ni-in ama omna panin paikhiasak kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Ni Sagih ni-in mite a tawlnga hi.
Israyl’ innkuan in tua an pen Manna a ci uh hi. A khiatna pen Bang a hia, a cihna ahi hi. Tua pen nanan tang kang tawh kibang a, a limna pen khuaizu tawh a kibawl mohpheng tawh ki bang hi.

Mosheh in, “Hih pen Yahweh thupiaksa ahi hi: ‘Hong piang ding suanlekhakte aa dingin manna omer khat la unla, kem un; tua hileh Egypt gam panin note Kong paikhiatpih hun lai-in gamlak-a note’ nek dingin kong piak an, amaute in mu ding uh hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh in Aaron sawl a, “Beel khat la inla, tua sungah manna omer dim khat koih-in a khang sawnte aa dingin a kikem dingin Yahweh mai-ah kem in.
Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin, Aaron in kep dingin Tecipanna mai-ah koih hi.

Omer khat pen ephah seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat ahi hi.

Ahih hangin tua munah tui duh-in mite dangtak uh a, Mosheh tungah mite phun-in, “Kote leh ka tate leh ka ganhingte uh dangtakin a si dingin bang hangin Egypt panin kote hong paikhiatpih na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Yahweh tungah Mosheh kiko-in, “Hih mite aa dingin keimah in bang hih thei ding ka hi hiam? Amaute in suang tawh kei hong den sawmsawm ta uh hi!” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Israyl upate pawl khat sam inla, mite mai-ah pai in. Nile gun na satna ciangkhut zong na khut sungah tawi inla, pai in.

En in, Horeb-a suangpi tung, na mai-ah Ka ding ding hi; nang in suangpi na sat ding a, mipite dawn ding tui tua panin hong luangkhia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Mosheh in Israyl upate muhna ah a hih hi.

Tua ahih manin Israyl mite kitot kinialna hangin leh amaute in Yahweh a ze-etin, “Eite lakah Yahweh hong om hiam omlo hiam?” a cihna hangin amah in tua mun pen Massah; tua pen ze-etna a cihna ahi hi, leh Meribah ci-in min a phuak hi; tua pen Kitawtna, Kinialna a cihna ahi hi.

Mosheh in Yahshua kiangah, “Mi kimkhat tengkhia inla, Amalek mite a do dingin kuankhia in. Zingciangin keimah in ka khut sungah Yahweh’ ciangkhut tawi-in mual dawn ah ka ding ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mosheh in ama kiangah a gensa bangin Yahshua gamta a, Amalek mite tawh a kido uh hi. Mual dawn ah Mosheh, Aaron, leh Hur a pai to uh hi.
