Tua ahih manin Yahshua in Amalek leh ama mite namsau hiam tawh a zo hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Keimah in van nuai panin Amalek mite a kiphawkna ka phiatsiang ding phawk tawntungna khat dingin hih pen laizial tungah gelh inla, Yahshua zakin simkik in,” a ci hi.
Mosheh in biaknatau khat lamin a min Yahweh Nissi a phuak a; tua in Yahweh pen keima Gualzawhna lan hi, a cihna ahi hi.
amah in, “Yahweh kumpi tokhom dongah khutte kilamto hi. Yahweh in a khang a khangin Amalek mite do ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh leh Ama mi Israyl-te aa dingin a bawlsakna leh Egypt gam panin Yahweh in Israyl mite bang ci bangin a paikhiatpihna khempeuh, Mosheh’ sungpa ahi Midian siampi Yethro in za hi.
Mosheh in a zi Zipporah a sawlkik khita kipanin, Mosheh’ sungpa Yethro in Zipporah leh
a tapa nihte kem hi; a tapa khat min pen Gershom ahi hi; tua pen Tua mun-a Khualmi a cihna ahi hi, bang hang hiam cihleh Mosheh in, “Kei pen gamdangpi khat ah khualmi ka hi hi,” a ci hi;

adang khat’ min pen Yliezer ahi hi; tua in Ka Vangliatna pen Panpihna hi, a cihna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Ka pa’ Pa pen kei hong panpih pa hi; Amah in Pharaoh’ namsau panin kei hong honkhia hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh’ mual ah giahphual a satna gamlak Mosheh kiangah Mosheh’ tapate leh a zi tawh, a sungpa Yethro hong pai hi.
Yethro in Mosheh kiangah kam vaikhak a, “Na zi leh a tapa tenih tawh nang kiangah kong pai hi,” ci-in kamtai a sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mosheh a sungpa a dawn dingin paikhia a, amah kunsukin a nam hi. Amaute khatlekhat omzia kidong tuak uh a, puanbuk sungah a pai uh hi;

Israyl mite hangin Pharaoh’ tung leh Egypt mite’ tungah Yahweh in a hihna khempeuh, lam-ah amaute tunga a tung haksatna khempeuh leh Yahweh in amaute bangci hotkhiat cih thu Mosheh in Yethro kiangah a gen hi.
Yahweh in Egypt-te khut sung panin Israyl-te honkhia a, amau aa dingin Ama sepsaksa thuphate khempeuh hangin Yethro a lungdam hi.
Yethro in, “Egypt mite gam sung panin note hong honkhia, leh Egypt mite leh Pharaoh’ khut sung panin note hong honkhia Yahweh kiphat ta hen.
Tu-in Yahweh pen pasian khempeuh sangin a liatzawkna ka thei ta hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl mite tungah kiliatsakna tawh a gamta mite’ tungah Amah in hih bangin a hih hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh’ sungpa Yethro in meihal biakpiakna khat nei-in Yahweh tungah biakpiakna a pia hi. Yahweh mai-ah Yethro tawh an ne dingin Israyl upate khempeuh tawh Aaron a pai hi.
A zingciangin mite thu a khen dingin Mosheh tu a, zingsang panin nitak dong ama kiim-ah mite ding uh hi.

Mite aa dingin Mosheh sepnate khempeuh Yethro in a muh ciangin amah in, “Mite aa dingin, nang sep pen bang ahi hiam? Zingsang panin nitak dong na kiim ah hih mite a din laitakin nang bek bang hangin thukhenin tu na hi hiam?’ a ci hi.
Mosheh in Yethro dawng a, “Bang hang hiam cihleh mite in Yahweh’ thu kan dingin kei kiangah a hong pai ahi uh hi.
Amaute in thu a neih uh ciangin kei kiangah hong pai uh a, mite kikal ah keimah in ka khensat hi; keimah in Yahweh’ ngeina kipte amaute ka theisak a, Ama Thukhamte ka hilh hi.
Mosheh’ sungpa in tua ciangin ama kiangah, “Hih bangin na hih pen na hoihpen hilo hi,” a ci hi.
Nang leh nangmah tawh a om mite in na zawngkhal lawh ding uh hi. Tua nasep pen nang aa dingin giklua a, nang kia bek in na sem zo kei ding hi.
Tu-in ka thu hong ngai in, thu kong lak ding hi; nang tawh Yahweh hong om ta hen. Yahweh mai-ah mite’ palai na hi dinga, amaute kisiatnate Ama tungah na puak ding hi.
Nangmah in biakna ngeina kipte leh thukhamte amaute na hilh dinga, amaute’ kalsuan zia ding leh amaute sepzia ding na lak ding hi.

Tua bek tham lo-in mi khempeuh lak panin Yahweh a zahtak, a muanhuai, sumgolh a mudah, mi siamte na teelkhia ding hi; amaute pen a tultul a uk ding, a zaza a uk ding, sawmngate a uk ding, sawmte a uk ding cih bangin na koih ding hi.

A tawntungin mite’ thu amaute khen sak in; ahih hangin thu haksate nang kiangah hong puak ding uh hi; thu neute pen amau le amau-in khensat ding uh hi. Tua hileh nang aa dingin baih zaw ding a, amaute in vangik hong puakpih a hi ding uh hi.
Hih bangin na hih a, Yahweh in zong tua bang thu hong piak leh, tua ciangin nangmah in na sem paisuak zo ding a, mite khempeuh zong amau omna ah lungkim takin ciah thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh in Yethro’ thu ngai a, ama gen bangin a hih hi.
Mosheh in misiamte teel a, mipite tungah lutang dingin amaute bawl a, a tultul a uk ding, a zaza a uk ding, sawmngate a uk ding, sawmte a uk dingin a koih hi.
A tawntungin amaute in mite thu a khen uh hi; thu haksate amaute in Mosheh kiangah puak uh a, ahih hangin thu neute pen amau le amau-in khensat uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in Yethro khakhia a, a gam ah amah a ciah hi.
Israyl mite Egypt leitang panin a paikhiat zawh a kha thumna sung tua ni teekteekin Sinai gamlak a tung uh hi.
Rephidim panin amaute ding khia-in, Sinai gamlak ah pai a mual mai-a gamlak ah giahphual sat uh hi.
Yahweh kiangah Mosheh paito a, mual panin Yahweh in amah sam a, “Yaaqob innkuan tungah na gen ding hih bang hi a, Israyl mite tungah gen in:
‘Egypt mite tungah Ka bawlna leh muvanlai in a kha tawh a note a puak bangin note hong pua-in Keima kiangah kong paipihna na mukhin uh hi.

Tua ahih manin tu-in note in Ka thuciamna letkipna tawh Ka thu nong man taktak uh leh, mi khempeuh lak panin a tuamvilvel Keima sumkholna khat na hi ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh leitung khempeuh Keima aa ahi hi.
Note pen Kei aa dingin siampi kumpi gam khat leh minam siangtho khat na hi ding uh hi. Hihte pen Israyl mite tungah na gen ding thukhamte ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh hong pai-in, mite lak panin upate sam a, Yahweh’ thukham kammalte khempeuh amaute mai-ah a sungkhia hi.
Mite khempeuh in dawng khawm uh a, “Yahweh in hong gensa khempeuh ka hih ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Mosheh in amaute dawnna Yahweh tungah a genkik hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Meii sahpi sung panin nang kiangah hong pai ding ka hi hi; tua ahih manin mite in nang tawh Ka kihona za ding a, a tawntungin nang hong um ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Mosheh in mite thugente Yahweh kiangah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Mite kiangah pai inla tuni-in amaute tuam omsak inla, zingciangin a puansilhte uh sawpsak in;
a ni thumna ni aa dingin amaute kigingsak in; bang hang hiam cihleh a ni thum ni-in mi khempeuh muhin Sinai Mual tungah Yahweh hong paisuk ding hi.

Nangmah in mite aa dingin ciangtanna khat mual kiimkotah koih inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Mual tungah paitoh ding hitaleh mual bul na lawn khak loh nadingun kidawm un,’ ci in. Tua mual a sukha peuhmah kithat ding hi;

amah suang tawh a kiden’ keileh thaltangte tawh kikap taktak ding hi; ama tungah khut khat beek kinga lo ding hi. Mihing ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin amah kinungtasak lo ding hi. Tuutal ki sau veipi hong kimuut ciangin amaute mual tungah hong pai to thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Mual tung panin mite kiangah Mosheh paisuk a, amaute siangthosakin tuam koih a, amaute in a puante uh a sawp uh hi;
Tua ciangin amah in mite kiangah, “Ni thum ni ciangin kigingsa in om un; numei tawh lumkhawm kei un,” a ci hi.
A ni thum ni, zingsang ciangin vangingin khuaphia a, mual tungah meii sahpi khat a om hi. Peengkul ging ngaihlua mahmah ahih manin giahphual sunga om mi khempeuh liing uh hi.
Yahweh tawh kimu dingin Mosheh in giahphual panin mite paikhiatpih a, amaute mual bul ah a ding uh hi.
Tu-in meikhu in Sinai Mual tuamcip hi; bang hang hiam cihleh mei sung tua mual tungah Yahweh hong kumsuk hi; a khu pen mei phualpi khu bangin kahto a, mi khempeuh nakpi takin liing uh hi.
Peengkul aw sauveipi a nak gin semsem ciangin Mosheh pau a, Yahweh’ awging in amah, awging tawh a dawng hi.
Sinai Mual tung, mual dawn ah Yahweh kumsuk a, tua mual dawn ah Yahweh in Mosheh samin Mosheh a paito hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Mite in Yahweh a en dingin kiphul gawp-a hong paisuakin amaute tampi tak a sih khak loh nadingin tuaksuk inla, amaute hilh khol in.
Yahweh kiang a hong pai siampite zong amau mah kisiangtho tawmsakin tuam om hen, tua bang ahih keileh amaute tungah Yahweh hong puakzak ding hi.

Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Sinai Mual tungah mite hong pai thei lo ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in kote nong hilhkhol a, ‘Mual kiimkotah ciangtanna khat koih inla, siangtho-in tuamkoih in,’ nong ci hi” a ci hi.

Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Paisuk inla, tua khit ciangin nang tawh Aaron hong paito un. Ahih hangin Yahweh kiangah a paito dingin siampite leh mite kiphul gawp-a hong paisuak vetlo ding uh hi; tua bang ahih keileh amaute tungah Amah hong puakzak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite kiangah Mosheh paisukin amaute kiangah a gen hi.
Yahweh in hih thute khempeuh gen hi:
“Keimah in saltanna inn pan leh Egypt leitang panin note a hong paikhiatpih Yahweh na Vantung Pa ka hi hi.
Note in a kikham pasiante (elohim) na nei peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen Kei tawh kileh ngat hi.
Tunga van ah ahi zongin nuai-a leitung ah ahi zongin nuai lama om vui sunga omte tawh a kibangin a kiseek milim khat peuhpeuh na bawl tawm kei ding uh hi.

Tuate mai-ah na kun kei ding uh a, a na uh zong na sem kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah Yahweh note Pa, in a haza Vantung Pa ka hi a, Kei hong mudahte’ tungah pate’ thukham palsatna hangin tate khang thum khang li na dong dantatin,
ahih hangin Ka thukhamte zuihna tawh Kei hong it mi, a tul tampite tungah itna a lak Pa ka hi hi.
Yahweh note Vantung Pa Min bang mahlo a suak dingin na paikhia kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Ama Min zahtak lo-a, a simmawh bawl peuhmah a mawh loin a seh kei ding hi.
Shabbat ni a siangtho-a zat ding phawk un.
Note nasep khempeuh ni guk sung tengin na sem ding uh a,

ahih hangin a ni Sagihna Ni pen Yahweh note Vantung Pa’ Shabbat ahi hi. Tua ni-in nang hitaleh na zi hitaleh na tapa hitaleh na tanu hitaleh na nasem pasal hitaleh na nasem numei hitaleh na ganhing hitaleh na huang sunga hong teng khualmi hitaleh in bangmah sem lo ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh ni guk sungin Yahweh in vantungte leh leitung, tuipi leh tuateng sunga om khempeuh bawl a, a ni Sagih Ni-in a tawlnga hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh in a ni Sagihna Ni thupha pia-in siangthosak hi; Yahweh in a ni Sagihna Ni a siangthosak hi.
Yahweh in note hong piak leitang tungah na khan uh a sau theih nadingin, na nu leh na pa thupibawl un. (Matt 15:4; Eph 6:2)
Mi na that kei ding uh hi. (Luke 6:31)
Nulepa mawhna na bawl kei ding uh hi.
Na gu kei ding uh hi.
Na vengte langah aman lo teci na pang kei ding uh hi.

Na vengpa’ inn na deihgawh; eng, deih ngeungau, kei ding uh hi; na vengpa’ zi, a nasempa, a nasemnu, a bawngtal, a laa, na vengpa’ neihsa khat peuhpeuh na deihgawh; deih ngeungau, kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Mi khempeuh in vanging leh khuaphia mu-in, peengkul aw za a, mual meikhu mu hi; mite in tua khempeuh a muh ciangin, amaute a gamla-ah ding a lau-in liing uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Mosheh kiangah, “Nangmah in kote kiangah thu hong gen in, ka ngai ding uh hi; ahih hangin Yahweh, kote hong hopih kei in, nong hopihsak leh ka si ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Mosheh in mite kiangah, “Lau kei un, bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in note hong ze-et ding leh hong encian dingin hong pai ahi hi. Tua hileh Yahweh aa dingin zahtakna pen note tawh hong om ding a, tua hileh note in mawhna na bawl kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Mite a gamla ah om lai uh a, ahih hangin Mosheh in Yahweh omna khuamial sahpi lam a zuan hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Hih pen Israyl mite tungah na gen ding ahi hi: ‘Vantung panin nang kong hopihna na mukhin hi:
Note aa dingin Ka kiang panin ngun tawh hitaleh kham tawh hitaleh a kibawl pasiante (elohim ahi a, teraphim ahi zongin) bawl kei un.

Kei aa dingin lei tawh biaknatau khat na bawl ding a, na tuute uh leh na bawngtalte uh tawh meihal biakpiaknate leh kilemna biaknate tua tungah na pia ding uh hi. Ka Min a kip nading Ka teelna mun peuhpeuh ah, note kiangah Kei kong pai ding a, note thupha kong pia ding hi.
Kei aa dingin suang tawh biaknatau na bawl uh leh, a kiseek suang tawh bawl kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh tua tungah van khat peuhpeuh na zat uh leh a ninsak na hi ding uh hi.
Na seelsim uh a kidawk loh nadingin Ka biaknatau ah kahlei tawh na kah kei ding uh hi.
Tu-in hihte pen amaute mai-ah na koih ding thukhennate ahi hi.
Hebrew mi sila khat na lei uh leh, amah in kum guk sung nangma na a sem ding hi. Ahih hangin a kum sagihna ah amah in bangmah piakkul loin suakta takin paikhia ding hi.
Amah a guakin hong pai ahih leh, amah guak mah kikhahkhia ding hi; ahih hangin amah hong pai lai-in amah in zi a neih leh, tua nu in amah a zui ding hi.
A pu in zi a neihsak a, tua nu in tanu tapa a neih leh a numei leh a tate a pu aa hi ding a, a pasal bek paikhia ding hi.
Ahih hangin nasempa in, ‘Ka pu*, ka zi leh ka tate ka it a, kei suakta takin ka paikhia kei ding hi’ ci-in kician takin a cih leh,

tua ciangin a pu in thukhente kiangah amah paipih ding hi. Amah in kongkhak ah ahi a, kongkhak khuam ah ahi zongin amah paipih ding a, phimpi khat tawh a bil vuhsak ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah pen a nuntak tawntungin a sila hi ding hi.
Mi khat in a tanu nasem numei khat dingin a zuak leh, tua nu pen nasem pasalte bangin paikhia lo ding hi.

A pu in ama zi dingin a sehsa tua numei in amah a lungkimsak kei leh, tua ciangin amah in tua nu kitankik sak ding hi. Amah in tua nu khualmi khat peuh kiangah a zuak theih nading thu nei lo hi, bang hang hiam cihleh amah in tua nu tawh a ciamna palsat hi.
Mi khat in a tapa aa dingin sila numei a lei leh, amah in tanu bangin tua nu bawl ding hi.
Amah in adang numei khat a tenpih leh, a zi masa’ annek, puansilh, leh lupkhop nading thuneihna khiam lo ding hi.
Amah in hih thu thumte tua nu aa dingin a bawl kei leh, tua ciangin sum bangmah piak kul loin tua nu suakta takin paikhia thei ding hi.
Mi khat satin a sisak mi peuhmah kithat taktak ding hi.
Ahi zongin amah in a thahsawm hi loin Yahweh in tua bangin a piang dingin a phal ahi leh, keimah in ka sehna mun ah amah a tai ding ahi hi.
Ahih hangin mi khat in mi dang khat thah ding tumin a thah leh, amah na thah theih nadingun note in Ka biaknatau a belhna nangawn panin amah na la teitei ding uh hi.
A pa hitaleh a nu hitaleh a sat mi pen kithat taktak ding hi.
Mi khat gu-in a zuak pa, ahih keileh, ama neihsa lakah a kimuh leh kithat taktak ding hi.
A pa hitaleh a nu hitaleh a samsia mi pen kithat taktak ding hi.
Mite kitawngin khat in suang tawh ahi a, khuttum tawh ahi zongin na khat peuhpeuh tawh hih-in, mipa si loin ahih hangin lupna tung ngakin,
mipa thozo-in ama ciangkhut tawh a vakkhiatkik zawh nakleh, amah a tum pa siang ding hi. Ahih hangin a liam mipa hun bei sungteng tang liau pelmawh ding a, a damsiang dong en ding hi.
Mi khat in a nasem pasal hitaleh a nasem numei hitaleh molhtum khat tawh satin a sih pah leh, amah kidantat pelmawh taktak ding a,
ahi zongin sila pen ni khat ni nih khawngin hong thawhkik leh, sila pen ama aa ahih manin amah pen dantat ding hilo hi.

Mite kilai-in numei naupaai khat a natsakin tua hangin tua nu tatolhin, ahi zongin siatna in a zuihbeh kei nakleh, tua nu’ pasal in ama tunga a cihzah tawh kituakin tua numei a liamsak mi kigam ding a, thukhente’ khenna bangin liau ding hi.
Ahih hangin Siatna khatpeuh a nasiat leh, note in nuntakna tang ding nuntakna,
Mit tang ding mit, ha-tang tang ding ha-tang, khut tang ding khut, khe tang ding khe,
meikang tang ding meikang, liamna tang ding liamna, siatna tang ding siatna na la ding uh hi.
Mi khat in a sila ahi pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh a mit satin a suksiatkhak leh amah in tua mit’ hangin sila suakta takin suaktasak pelmawh ding hi.
Mi khat in a sila pasal’ ha-tang hitaleh a sila numei’ ha-tang hitaleh a kiatsak leh, amah in tua ha-tang hangin sila suakta takin paisak ding hi.
Bawngtal khat in pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh a ki tawh siklup leh, tua ciangin tua bawngtal suang tawh kidenglum taktak ding a, a sa kine lo ding hi. Ahih hangin a bawngtal neipa siang ding hi.

Ahih hangin a hun beisa-ah bawngtal in mi si thei a, a nei pa kihilh napi-in a khumcip kei a, tua bawngtal in pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin a thah leh, bawngtal kidenglum ding a, a nei pa zong kithat ding hi.
Ama tung pan tatkhiatna sum a kinget leh, ama tunga a kingen zahzah tawh ama nuntakna kitankhia thei ding hi.
Tua bawngtal in mi’ tapa ahi a, tanu ahi zongin a ki tawh a pik leh hih thukhenna tawh kizui-in kigamta ding hi.
Bawngtal in nasem pasal hitaleh nasem numei hitaleh a ki tawh a pik leh, a bawng nei pa in amau’ pu tungah ngun shekel 30 pia ding a, bawngtal kideng lum ding hi.
Mi khat in dum khat sin loin ahih keileh, dum khat to-in a sit mangngilh a, tua sungah bawngtal khat ahih keileh laa khat a kiat leh,
dum nei pa in tua supna loh pelmawh ding hi; amah in a gan nei pa kiangah pia pelmawh ding a, a si gan pen ama aa hi ding hi.
Mi khat’ bawngtal in adang khat’ bawngtal liamsakin a sih leh, amaute in a hing pen zuak ding uh a, tua man hawm ding uh hi. A ganhing si pen zong amaute in hawm ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin bawngtal in mi si ngei hi, ci-in kithei napi-in a nei pa in a khumcip loh ahih leh, amah in bawngtal tang ding bawngtal pia ding a, a si ganhing pen amah in tang ding hi.

headings.text: Gamtatna leh Biakna tawh Kisai Thubulpite

verses.text: Mi khat in bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin gu a, that lum gawpin ahi a, zuakin ahi zongin ahih leh amah in bawngtal khat tang ding bawngtal nga, tuu khat tang ding tuu li a piakik ding hi.
Guta khat inn luh laitak kimu a, amah ki satin a sihleh, tua sisan luana hangin a sat pa a mawh kei hi.

Ahih hangin hih thupiang nisuah khit ahih leh, sisan luanna hangin amah a khial ahi hi. Guta khat in a guksa na a dimkik pelmawh ding hi; ahih hangin amah in bangmah a neih kei leh, a guksate a dit nadingin amah a kizuak pelmawh ding hi.
A kigu ganhing, bawngtal ahi a, laa ahi a, tuu ahi zongin a hing-in a gupa’ neihsa lakah a kimuh leh, amah in a zah nih-in loh kik ding hi
Mi khat in lo khat ahi a, leenggah lo ah ahi zongin gan tasakin a ganhing khah-in mi dang khat’ lo ah a tat leh amah in ama lo leh ama leenggah lo panin a hoih pen tawh ditkikna bawl ding hi.
Mei kuangin gam kang a, a kikhol an ahi a, a ding lai an ahi a, lo ahi zongin a kat leh, mei a kangsak pa in a cing takin ditkikna bawl pelmawh ding hi.
Mi khat in a sanggampa kiangah ngun ahi a, neihsate kep ding ap a, tua mipa inn panin kigu-in, a guta a kimuh leh amah in a zah nih pia ding hi.
Ahi zongin a guta a kimuh kei leh, tua ciangin adang mipa’ neihsa tungah a mah in a khutte a ngak leh a ngak loh a kikhensat nadingin inn neipa pen thukhente mai-ah kipaipih pelmawh ding hi.

Upadi tawh a kituak lo a om bawngtal, laa, tuu, puan, hitaleh “adang khat in kei aa hi” a cih adang khat neihsa a mang khatpeuh’ thu kineihna khempeuh ah, amau thu kineihnate a paipih dingin a lang nih-un thukhente mai-ah pai ding uh hi.

Mi khat in a sanggampa’ kiangah laa ahi a, bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin, ganhing khat peuhpeuh a kepsak dingin pia a, kuama muh lohin tua ganhing a si a hitaleh, a liam a hitaleh, a kihawlkhia ahi zongin ahih leh,

“a sanggampa in mipa’ neihsa a khoih kei hi” ci-in Yahweh mai-ah kiciamna tawh amaute nih kikal-a thu pen kikhentat ding hi. A neipa in hih kiciamna pen a san ding hi a, amah in ditkikna bawl lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin ama tung panin a kigu ahih leh, a neipa tungah amah in ditkikna bawl hamtang ding hi.
Gamsa in a balzan ahih leh, lahtel nadingin tua ganhing paipih sakin a kibalzan ganhing ditkikna amah in bawl ding kisam lo hi.
Mi khat in a sanggampa kiang panin ganhing khat peuh kawmin, a neipa om loin tua pen liam ahi a, si ahi zongin ahih leh amah in a kicingin ditkikna bawl ding hi.
Ahih hangin a neipa pen a ganhing tawh a om leh, a kawmpa in ditkikna pia lo ding hi. A kikawm ahih leh a kikawm bangin pai ding hi.
Mi khat in tenpih dingin a kidong nai lo nungak lai khat zolin amah tawh a lup khop leh, amah in tua nu’ man ding moman pia ding a, tua nu pen a zi hi pah ding hi.
A numei’ pa in ama tungah tua nu piak ding a nial leh, tua mipa in nungak lai ahihna a suksiatna hangin mo-man pia veve ding hi.
Numei aisan khat peuh na hingkhawi kei ding uh hi.
Ganhing tawh a mawh peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Yahweh bek sim loh, pasian (elohim) khat peuhpeuh tungah biakna a pia mi peuhmah kisusia mang ding hi.
Khualmi khat peuh bawlsia-in na nengniam kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note zong Egypt gam ah khualmi na hi uh hi.
Meigongte tung pan hitaleh tagahte tung pan hitaleh a met na dok kei ding uh hi.
Note in amaute na gawt uh a, amaute Kei’ tungah hong kiko leh, amaute kikona Ka za taktak ding a,
Ka hehna so ding a, Keimah in note namsau tawh kong that ding hi. Na zite uh meigong suakin, na tate pa neilo a suak ding uh hi.
Note lak a a nei lo Ka mite khat peuh tungah sum leitawi na piak uh leh, ama tungah sum leitawi a piapa bangin na om kei ding uh a, ama tung panin a meet zong na dok kei ding uh hi.
Khapna hangin na sanggampa puansilh na lak leh, nitum ma-in piakik in.

Bang hang hiam cihleh tua kituamna bek a pumpi aa dingin a neih tua puan ahi hi. Adang bang tawh ihmu-in lum ding ahi hiam? Ka kiangah amah hong kiko ciangin hih bang piang kha ding hi; hehpihna nei ka hih manin ama kikona Ka za ding hi.
Yahweh na gensia kei ding uh a, na thukhente zong gensia loin na mite uh a ukpa zong na samsia kei ding uh hi.
Na an pal hitaleh na leenggah huan pan-a piang peuhpeuh piak ding na zekai kei ding uh hi. Na tacil pasalte uh Keima tungah nong pia ding uh hi.
Na bawngtalte leh na tuute uh tawh tua bangmahin na hih ding uh hi. Ni sagih sung a pi tawh om ding a, a ni giatna ni ciangin Kei kiangah nong pia ding uh hi.
Note pen Ka mi siangthote a suak ding na hi uh hi; gamsate balzan ganhing sa peuhmah zong na ne kei ding uh a, uite kiangah na lot ding uh hi.
A man lo thu hong kipuak na genthang kei ding uh hi. A man lo teci panna tawh mi gilopa na panpih kei ding uh hi.
A sia bawl dingin mihonpite nung na zui kei un. Thu kineihna khat peuh ah teci na pan ciangin, mi honpi lamah pankhopna tawh thuman na heikhia kei ding uh hi.
Thu kineihna ah mi zawngpa lang neihin, gup tuam na nei kei ding uh hi.
Na galte’ bawngtal ahi a, a laa ahi zongin a gammang na tuah leh ama kiangah na puakkik ding hi.
Nang hong muhdah khat peuh’ laa vanlel-a puk na muh leh, taisan loin phongin na uh taktak ding hi.
Mi zawngpa thu kineihna ah thuman loin thu na khen peuhmah kei ding hi.
A man lo thu khat peuhpeuh panin nanglenang kikem inla; mawhna nei lo mipa ahi a, thuman mipa ahi zongin that kei un, bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in mawhneipa Ka khah kei ding hi.
Sumgolh na sang kei ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh sumgolh in mipilte mittawsak a, thuman mi’ kammal heikhiatsak hi.
Khualmi khat peuhpeuh zong na nengniam kei ding uh hi, note in khualmi’ lungsim na thei uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt gam sungah note khualmi na hi uh hi.
Kum guk sung na lo uh ah khai tuhin a piangte na kaikhawm ding uh a,

ahih hangin a kum sagihna kum ciangin tua lo tawlngasakin khawh lohin na koih ding uh hi, tua hileh note laka mizawngte in tua panin a an ding uh la ding a, a cian peuhpeuh gamsate in ngah ding uh hi. Na leenggah lo leh na olive lote uh zong tua mah bangin na hih ding uh hi.

Ni guk sung na nasep uh na sem ding uh hi. Ahih hangin na bawngtal leh na laa in, tawlngakna a neih theih nading leh na nasem numei’ tapa leh khualmite in thathak a ngah theih nadingin a ni sagihna ni-in na tawlnga ding uh hi.
Note tunga kong gensa thu khempeuh limtakin thudon unla, kidawm un. A kikham pasiante (elohim) min lo kei unla, tua bangte na kam panun zong kizasak kei un.
Kum khatin thumvei Keima aa dingin pawi na bawl ding uh hi.

Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Mangbuh-ham a vuih thak kha, Abib Kha sung a kisehsa hun ah kong thupiaksa bangin silngo sawh loh anlum ni sagih sung na ne ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua kha sungin Egypt panin na paikhia uh hi; Ka mai-ah khut hawm guak tawh kuamah hong kilaak lo ding hi;
Lo-a na tuh uh gah masate tawh Anlak Pawi na bawl ding uh hi; lo panin na ante uh na kaihkhopkhit uh kum bei ciangin, Kaihkhopna Pawi na bawl ding uh hi.
Pasal khempeuh kum khatin thumvei Yahweh mai-ah na kilaak ding uh hi.
Note in Keima biakpiakna sisan pen silngo sawh anlum tawh na pia khawm kei ding uh a, Keima biakpiakna ganhing thau zong zingsang dong na ciansak kei ding uh hi.
Na lo panin anpalte lakah a tung masa pen, Yahweh’ Inn ah na paipih ding uh hi. Note in a pi’ nawizu sungah keelno na huan kei ding uh hi.
En un, lampi ah note hong kem ding leh Ka bawlkholhsa mun ah hong paipih dingin note mai-ah vantungmi khat Ka sawl ding hi.
Amah thudon unla, Ama thu mang un; Amah langdo kei un, bang hang hiam cihleh note thu palsatna Amah in hong maisak lo ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh Ama sungah Ka Min om hi.
Ahih hangin Ama thugente mang takpi-inn, Ka gen khempeuh na zuih uh leh, na galte uh’ tungah gal Ka hi ding a, na langte uh’ tungah lang Ka hi ding hi.

Ahang in note mai-ah Ka vantungmi pai ding a, Amor mite gam, Hit mite gam, Periz mite gam, Canaan mite gam, Hiv mite gam leh Yebus mite gam sungah note hong paipih ding hi; Keimah in amaute Ka botkhia ding hi.

Amau pasiante (elohim) mai-ah na kun kei ding uh a, amaute’ na sem loin, amau gamtat bangin na gamta kei ding uh hi; note in amaute na lawnthal mang kiuhkeuhin amau’ milim khuampite na satzan gawp ding uh hi.
Note in Yahweh na Pa uh’ na na sem ding uh a, Amah in na an le tui uh thupha pia ding a, note lak panin cinatna Ka lakhia ding hi.
Na gam sung uh ah nausiatna hitaleh a tasel hitaleh om lo ding hi; na nuntak kum Ka kicingsak ding hi.
Note mai-ah Ka lauhuaina ka sawl ding a, note phutkhak ding minam peuhpeuh Ka buaisak ding a, na galte khempeuh uh ka lehtaisak ding hi.
Note mai panin Hiv mite, Canaan mite leh Hit mite a hawlkhia dingin, note mai-ah khuaizantate Ka sawl ding.
Note aa dingin leitang gamkhing suakin gamsa tam lua ding ahih manin note mai panin kum khat sungin amaute Ka hawlkhia kei ding hi.
Note khangin leitang na luah matengun note mai panin amaute tawmtawmin Ka hawlkhia ding hi.

Keimah in Tuipi San panin Philistine Tuipi dong, sehnel gam panin, Euphrates Gun dongah note gamgi Ka phut ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tua gam a teng mite note’ khut sungah kong pia ding a, note mai panin amaute na hawlkhia mang ding uh hi.
Amaute ahi a amau’ pasiante (elohim) tawh ahi zongin thuciamna na bawl kei ding uh hi.

Amaute in Kei’ tungah note hong khialsak kha ding ahih manin note gam sungah amaute na tengsak kei ding uh hi; ahang in amau’ pasiante na biak uh leh, tua pen note tungah thangzak khat hong hi taktak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in Mosheh kiangah, “Nang leh Aaron, Nadab leh Abihu, leh Israyl upa 70-te Yahweh kiangah hong paito un. Note in a gamla panin a bia ding na hi uh a,
Yahweh kiang nai ah Mosheh bek pai ding hi; ahih hangin amaute a nai-ah hong pai lo ding uh a, mihonpite amah tawh hong kahto lo ding hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh pai-in Yahweh’ kammalte khempeuh leh Yahweh’ thukhennate khempeuh mite gen a; mite khempeuh in aw kikhatin dawng uh a, “Yahweh’ gensa thute khempeuh ka hih ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh in Yahweh’ thukhamte khempeuh gelh a, zingsangin tho baihin mual bul ah biaknatau khat lamin, Israyl minam sawm-le-nih tawh kizui-in khuampi sawm-le-nih a phut hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Israyl mi tangvalte sawlin, amaute in meihal biakna leh kilemna biakna bawngtalte Yahweh tungah a pia uh hi.
Mosheh in sisan kimkhat la-in, kuangte sungah koih a, sisan kimkhat biaknatau tungah a theh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in Thuciamna Laibu la-in, mite kiangah sim a, amaute in, “Yahweh’ gensa khempeuh kote in hihin ka thumang ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in tua sisan la-in mite’ tungah theh a, “Hih thukhamte khempeuh tawh kizui-in Yahweh in note tawh a bawl thuciamna sisan en un,” a ci hi.
Mosheh paito-in Aaron, Nadab leh Abihu, leh Israyl upa 70-te in zong a zui uh hi.
Amaute in Israyl mite’ Vantung Pa a mu uh hi. Ama khe nuai-ah van bangin a siang sapphire tawh a kibawl suangphah khat tawh a kibang bang-hiam-khat a om hi.
Israyl mi ahi, hih mi thupite’ tungah a khut a lik kei hi; amaute in Yahweh mu a, tua ciangin amaute in an ne-in tui a dawn uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Mual tung Kei kiangah hong paito in, tua lai mun ah om in. Amaute na hilh theih nadingin Keima gelhsa thukham leh thupiakte, suangpeekte nang’ tungah kong pia ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh zong amah a huhpa Yahshua kizuisak a, Yahweh’ mual tungah Mosheh a paito hi.
Amah in upate kiangah, “Kong kilehkik matengun hih lai mun ah hong ngak un. Aaron leh Hur pen note tawh hong om taktak hi. Thu kineihna khat peuhpeuh a om leh, amaute kiangah paisak un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mual tungah Mosheh paito a, meii in mual a tuam hi.
Yahweh’ minthanna vang pen Sinai Mual tungah kinga a, meii in ni guk sung a tuamcip hi. A ni Sagih Ni ciangin meii lak panin Yahweh in Mosheh a sam hi.
Israyl mite mit ah Yahweh minthanna vang a muh dan uh pen mualvum dawn a kangtum meikuang tawh kibang hi.
Mual tungah a paito kawmkawmin meii lakah Mosheh lut a, mual tungah sun 40 leh zan 40 a om hi.

headings.text: Israyl Mite in Biakna Paipih Ding

verses.text: Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah thugen a,
“Kei aa dingin biakna khat hong paipih na dingin Israyl mite kiangah gen in. A pia nuam mi peuhpeuh kiang panin Kei hong kipiakna na la ding hi;
Amaute kiang panin na lak ding piakna pen hihte ahi hi: kham, ngun, leh sumngo,
a dum, a dupsan leh a ausan puante leh hoihtak a kikhuk a kigan puante leh keel mul,
a kisansak tuutal vunte, keel vunte, leh singkha sing,
meivak aa ding sathau, nilh sathau aa ding leh gimnamtui aa dingin a namtuite,
siampi puan tung leh awmdal tunga suan dingin Onyx suangte leh suang manphate ahi hi.
Amaute’ lakah Ka om theih nadingin Kei aa dingin mun siangtho khat amaute bawlsak in.
Biakbuk lim leh a sunga vanzatte’ lim khempeuh, kong lahna khempeuh tawh kituakin na bawl teekteek ding hi.
Amaute in singkha sing tawh singkuang khat bawl ding uh a, a dung cubit 2 ½; pi 3 leh letmat 9, a vai cubit 1 ½; pi 2 leh letmat 3, hi ding hi.
Nangmah in kham citak tawh tua singkuang a sung leh a pua na zut ding a, a tung kiimkotah kham tawh a geihual na bawl ding hi.
Nangmah in a kiu lite aa dingin kham kual li sungin a singkuang khe li tungah tuate na bulh ding a, a pang khat ah kual nih, a pang langkhat ah kual nih mah na bulh ding hi.
Tua ciangin singkha singzawl na sui ding a, tuate kham tawh na zut ding hi.
singkuang pen kipua thei nadingin singkuang pangte-a a kualte sungah a singzawlte na khum ding hi.
Singkuang’ kualte sungah a zawlte omsuak ding a, tuate kilakhia lo ding hi.
Nang’ tunga kong piak ding Tecipanna singkuang sungah na koih ding hi.
Kham citak tawh hehpihna tokhom; Mawhkhuhna sin, khat bawl in. A dung cubit 2 ½; pi 3 leh letmat 9, a vai cubit 1 ½; pi 2 leh letmat 3, hi ding hi.
A kiseek kham tawh cherub nih bawl inla, hehpihna tokhom mong nihte ah tuate na koih ding hi:
a mong khat ah cherub khat, a mong langkhat ah cherub khat na bawl ding hi. Hehpihna tokhom tawh a kizomin a mong tuak ah cherub-te na bawl ding hi.
Cherub-te in a kha uh a tunglam-ah zal ding uh a, a kha-te tawh hehpihna tokhom tuam ding uh hi; amaute khat-le-khat kimaingat ding uh a, a mai tuak uh a tuamna lamah ngasuk ding hi.
Singkuang tungah hehpihna tokhom na koih ding hi; Keimah in kong piak ding Tecipanna pen singkuang sungah na koih ding hi.

Tua lai mun ah nang tawh i kimu ding a, Israyl mite aa dingin nang’ tungah Kong piak ding thukham sunga thute khempeuh hehpihna tokhom tung, Tecipanna singkuang tunga om cherub nihte kikal panin nang’ tungah Kong gen ding hi.
Singkha sing tawh sabuai khat bawl inla, a dung cubit 2; pi 3 kiim, a vai cubit 1; pi 1 leh letmat 6 kiim, leh a sanna cubit 1 ½; pi 2 leh letmat 3 kiim hi ding hi.
Kham citak tawh na zut ding a,a kiimkotah a geihual na bawl ding hi.
Tua kiimkotah khutpeek cia a zai zawl peek khat zong bawl inla, tua zawl peek kiimkotah a geihual na bawl ding hi.
Tua sabuai aa dingin kham kual li bawl inla, a khe lite a omna a nawl lite ah na gak ding hi.
Sabuai puak nading a zawlte a len dingin a zawl peek gei-ah a kualte om ding hi.
Singkha sing tawh a zawlte bawl inla, kham tawh zut-in tuate tawh sabuai na pua ding uh hi.
Kham citak tawh pakante leh sikkeu letna saute bawl inla, biakna sunkhiat nadingin thawl gongbak letna neite zong tua mah bangin bawl in.
Ka mai-ah a om tawntung dingin sabuai tungah ompihna anlum koih in.
Kham citak tawh meivakkhuam khat na bawl inla, a bul leh a kungte seek in. Pak tawh a kibang hai neute, a ngumte, a palhte pen sakhat-a a kizom khawm hi ding hi.
Meivakkhuam pangte panin hiang guk meengkhia ding a, a pang khat ah thum, adang langkhat ah thum hi ding hi.

Almond pakte tawh a kibang hai neu thumte pen hiangkhat tungah a ngumte leh a palhte tawh om khawm ding a; a zom hiang tungah thum mah omin tua hiang gukte khempeuh a kibangin meivakkhuam panin meengkhia ding hi.
A meivakkhuam tung mahmah ah a ngumte leh a palhte tawh a om, almond bangin a kibawl hai neu li omin;
Meivakkhuam panin a meengkhia hiang kop masa pen bul nuai-ah a ngum khat om ding a, a hiang kop nihna nuai-ah ngum khat, a thumna hiang kop ah zong ngum khat mah om ding a, a vekin hiang guk ahi hi.
A ngumte leh a hiangte pen meivakkhuam tawh sakhat hi ding a, kham citak tawh a kiseek hi ding hi.
Tua ciangin ama aa dingin meivak sagihte na bawl ding a, ama omna maiteng a tangsak dingin tua meivak sagihte meivakna tungah kikoih ding hi.
A taitehte leh a kuangte kham citak hi ding hi.
Meivakkhuam leh vanzatte khempeuhte aa dingin talent khat a gik; pound 75 kiim a gik, kham citak na zang ding hi.
Mual tungah nang hong kilak lim tawh kizui-in tuate na bawl ding thei in.
A kopin a kikhuk a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khau hoih tawh a kigan dalna puan sawm, tuate tungah khutsiamte in cherub-te tawh a zep biakbuk na bawl ding hi.
Dalna puante khempeuh kikim ding hi: a dung cubit 28; pi 42 kiim, sau ding a, a vai cubit 4; pi 6 kiim, zai ding hi.
Dalna puan ngate pehkhawm inla, adang ngate zong tua mah bangin hih in.
A kipehkhawm dalna puan kopkhat’ nawl dungsuk ah a dum bilvangte na bawl ding hi; adang langkhat-a dalna puan mong zong tua mah bangin hih in.
Dalna puan khat tungah bilvang 50 bawlin a kop dang langkhat dalna puan mong ah zong bilvang 50 mah bawl in; tua hileh khat lama bilvangte pen adang langkhat lama bilvangte tawh kitang ding uh hi.
Biakbuk pen bukhat a suah theih nadingin nangmah in kham tawh a kibawl kilhna 50 bawlin, tua kilhnate tawh dalna puan khatlekhat na kimatsak ding hi.
Biakbuk a tung khuh nadingin keelmul puante na bawl ding a, avekin dalna puan 11 a pha ding hi.
Dalna puan 11-te khempeuh kikim ding hi: a dung cubit 30; pi 45 kiim, sau ding a, a vai cubit 4; pi 6 kiim, zai ding hi.
Dalna puan ngate kopkhat ahi dingin pehkhawm inla, adang gukte kopkhatin pehkhawm in. A gukna dalna puan pen puanbuk mai-ah khepnihin na khep ding hi.
A kipehkhawm dalna puan nawl dungsuk ah bilvang 50 bawl inla, adang dalna puan khop nawl dungsuk ah zong tua mah bangin bawl in.
Tua ciangin puanbuk kiptakin bukhat a suah theih nadingin sumngo tawh a kibawl kilhna 50 bawl inla, bilvangte sungah tuate thun in.
Dalna puanbuk a valkhia, puan a lang val pen, biakbuk nungah kaisuk ding hi.
Puanbuk puante pen a dunglam a panglang tuak ah cubit khat; pi 1 leh letmat 6 kiim, ta a val pen pen biakbuk pangte a khuh theih nadingin biakbuk pangte ah kaisuk ding hi.
Puanbuk khuh nadingin a kisansak tuutal vunte bawl inla, tuate’ tungah keel vunte tawh khuhna khat bawl in.
Biakbuk aa dingin a kitungto singkha sing khuampeekte na bawl ding hi.
Khuampeek khat pen a tun cubit 10; pi 15 kiim, hi ding a, a vai cubit 1 ½; pi 2 leh letmat 3 kiim, hi ding hi.
A bulh khop nadingin khuampeek khat ciat ah a tonkhawmin a dawk nih na bawl ding hi. Biakbuk khuampeekte khempeuh tua bangin na bawl ding hi.
Biakbuk leitaw lam aa dingin khuampeek 20 bawl inla,
Khuampeekte’ bulah bullen ngun 40 bawlin, khuampeek khat ciat aa dingin bullen nih: a dawkkhia khat ciat nuai ah khat ta hi ding hi.
Adang langkhat lam, biakbuk’ leilu lam aa dingin khuampeek 20 bawl inla,
1 bullen ngun 40, khuampeek khat ciat nuai ah nihta bawl in.
a nung lam mong, biakbuk’ nitumna lam aa dingin khuampeek guk na bawl ding hi.
A nunglam kiute aa dingin khuampeek nih bawl in.
Hih a kiu nihte ah, khuampeekte a bul panin a dawn dongah a kop hi ding a, kual khat sungah kikhum khawm ding a, anih tuakin tua bang danin hi ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khuampeek giat, bullen ngun 16, khuampeek khat ciat nuai-ah bullen nihta om ding hi.
Singkha sing zawlte zong na bawl ding a, khuampeekte aa dingin biakbuk langkhat lam tungah zawl nga na bawl ding hi:
adang langkhat khuampeek dingin nga na bawl ding a, nitumna lam, biakinn nunglam-a khuampeek dingin zong nga mah na bawl ding uh hi.
A zawl lai pen in khuampeekte laizangah mong khat pan mong khat dong bansuak ding hi.
Khuampeekte kham tawh na zut ding a, a zawlte a len dingin kham kualte bawl in. A zawlte zong kham tawh zut in.
Mual tunga nang hong kilak lim bangin biakbuk na dingtosak ding hi.
A dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih kigan tawh dalna puan khat na bawl ding a, khutsiamte in cherub-te tawh zem ding hi.
Bullen ngun lite tunga om, kham kibawl vankhaina nei-in kham tawh a kizut singkha khuampi lite tungah na khai ding hi.
A kilhnate ah dalna puan pen khaisuk inla, Tua dalna puan nungah Tecipanna singkuang koih in. Tua dalna puan in a Siangtho Pen Mun panin a Siangtho Mun khen ding hi.
A Siangtho Pen Mun sunga Tecipanna singkuang tungah hehpihna tokhom koih in.
Dalna puan pualam, biakbuk’ leilu lamah sabuai koih inla, sabuai tawh a kimaingatin a leitaw lamah meivakkhuam koih in.
Puanbuk sung lutna dingin, siamgante gat a dupsan, a ausan, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan kong puan khat bawl in.
Kong puan aa dingin kham tawh a kibawl a khainate bawl inla, kham tawh a kizut singkha khuampi nga bawl in. Tuate aa dingin sumngo bullen nga bawl in.

Singkha sing tawh biaknatau khat lam inla, a sanna cubit 3; pi 4 leh letmat 6 kiim, sang ding hi. A dung a vai a kikim killi nei hi ding a, a dung cubit 5; pi 7 leh letmat 6 kiim, a vai cubit 5; pi 7 leh letmat 6 kiim, ta hi ding hi.
A kite leh biaknatau pen sakhat ahih nadingin a kiu li ciat ah ki khat ta na bawl ding hi a, sumngo na zut ding hi.
Sumngo tawh a ki bawl ama vanzatte khempeuh ahi: vut koih nadingin beelte, kawbiate, kuangte, sikkate leh vutluahna peekte na bawl ding hi.
Ama aa ding siklen sumngo tawh a kibawl a vang simsiam, leh siklen tung, a kiu lite ah sumngo kual li na bawl ding hi.
Siklen in biaknatau kim ciang a bat toh theih nadingin biaknatau zawl nuai panin na bulh ding hi.
Biaknatau aa dingin singkha sing tawh zawlte na bawl ding a, sumngo na zut ding hi.
Biaknatau a kipuak ciangin biaknatau’ pang nihte ah a zawlte om theih nadingin a kualte vang sungah a zawlte kikhum ding hi.
Singpeekte tawh kuak nei-in biaknatau na bawl ding hi. Mual tungah nang hong kilak bangin, amaute in bawl ding uh hi.
Biakbuk aa dingin buktual khat bawl in. Leitaw lam pen cubit 100; pi 150 kiim, sau ding a, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan a kikhai suk dalna puan a neih ding ahi hi;
Khuam 20 leh sumngo bullen 20, ngun tawh a kibawl a khainate leh a gaknate tawh bawl in.
Leilu lam zong cubit 100; pi 150 kiim, mah sau ding a, dalna puante nei-in, khuam 20, sumngo bullen 20, leh ngun tawh a kibawl a khainate leh a gaknate tawh na bawl ding hi.
A buktual mong nitumna lam pen cubit 50; pi 75 kiim, zai ding a, khuampi sawm leh bullen sawm tawh dalna puante nei ding hi.
A mailam, nisuahna lam buktual pen a vailam zong cubit 50 hi ding hi.
Kongpi pang khat-a ding, a kikhaisuk dalna puan pen khuam thum leh bullen thumte tawh cubit 15; pi 22 leh letmat 6 kiim, ta hi ding a,
A dang pang khat lam-a kongpi aa dingin khuam thum leh bullen thumte tawh a kikhaisuk dalna puan cubit 15 sau om ding hi.

Buktual lutna kongpi aa dingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khau a kopin a kikhuk khau hoihte tawh a kigan, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem, cubit 20; pi 30 kiim, a sau kongpuankhai khat om ding a, tua pen khuampi thum leh bullen thumte tawh hi ding hi.
Buktual kiima khuampi khempeuh pen ngun tawh kibawl gakna tawh a kigak hi ding a, a vankhainate ngun hi-in a bullente sumngo hi ding hi.

Buktual pen a dung cubit 100; pi 150 kiim, hi ding a, a vai pen cubit 50; pi 75 kiim, hi-in, cubit 5; pi 7 leh letmat 6 kiim, a sang a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan a kikhaisuk dalna puan leh sumngo bullente tawh hi ding hi.
Biakbuk nasepna-a a kizang adang nazat-te khempeuh, a khetphimte khempeuh leh buktual a khetphimte khempeuh sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding hi.
Meivak a kuangin a om tawntung theih nadingin meivak aa dingin Israyl mite in a kisuzan olive’ thau siangkilkel nang kiangah hong paipih nadingin thupia in.

Tecipanna mai-a om Dalna puan pualam-a Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah, Aaron leh ama tapate in nitak a kipan zingsang dong Yahweh mai-ah meivak a kuang den nading vil gige ding uh hi. Hih pen Israyl mite hih ding amau’ suanlekhakte aa dingin tawntung ngeina kip khat hi ding hi.
Israyl mite lak panin na sanggampa Aaron, ama tapate Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, leh Ithamar-te zong na kiangah paipih in; tua hileh Keima tungah siampi nasep hong sem thei ding uh hi.
Minthanna leh hoihna tawh a kidim nadingin na sanggampa Aaron aa dingin a puan siangtho na bawl ding hi.
Aaron aa ding sehtuam leh a siangtho nading puante, amaute in a bawl theih nadingin tua bang lamah pilna Ka guat a siam mi khempeuh kiangah gen in.

Hihte pen amaute in Siampi Lian aa dingin a bawl ding uh puante ahi hi: Awmdal khat, siampipuan khat, puantualpi khat, a kigan puantungsilh khat, dialkhip khat, leh kawnggak khat ahi hi. Amaute in na sanggampa Aaron aa dingin puan siangtho leh a tapate aa dingin adang siampi puante bawlsak ding uh hi; tua ahih manin amaute in Kei’ tungah siampi nasep hong sem thei ding uh hi.
Kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte amaute zangsak in.
Amaute in Siampi Lian’ siampi puan pen kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh bawl ding uh a, a siam khutsiam mi’ bawl hi ding hi.
A kizop khop theih nadingin a mong nihte ah a kimat liangkaihna puan nih nei ding hi.
Amah a gak dingin hoihtakin a kigan puan pen siampi puan tawh sakhat hi ding a; kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk puan hoihte tawh bawl ding ahi hi.
Onyx suang nih la inla, Israyl’ tapate min tuate tungah gelh in.
Amau suahna tawh kizui-in onyx suang khat tungah min guk gelh inla, a om lai min guk teng pen adang khat tungah gelh in.
Suangmanpha at pa in seal a khuak bangin Israyl tapate’ minte tua suang nihte tungah khuakin gelh in. Tua ciangin kham sungah phutsuk inla,

Israyl’ tapate aa dingin phawkna suangte ahi dingin siampi puan liangkaihna tungah tuate bulh kip in. Yahweh mai-ah phawkna ahi dingin Aaron in ama liangko nihte tungah suangin Yahweh mai-ah amau’ minte a paipih ding hi.
Kham tawh kibawl a kiphumna,
leh khau bangin a kihual, kham citak khainiang nih bawl inla, a kiphumna ah khainiangte bangkhawm in.
Thukhenna aa dingin a siam khutsiamte in awmdal khat na bawlsak ding hi. Siampi puan a kibawl mah bangin kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk puan hoih tawh bawl in.
A dung a vai a kikim killi nei hi ding a, a dung letmat 9, a vai letmat 9 mah hi-in thuap nih hi ding hi.
Tua ciangin a pang li pan khat ciat ah a manpha mahmah suangte thuah in. A pang masa tungah ruby suang khat, topaz suang khat, leh beryl suang khat;
a pang nihna tungah turquoise suang khat, sapphire suang khat, leh emerald suang khat;
a pang thumna tungah jacinth suang khat, agate suang khat, leh amethyst suang khat;
a pang lina tungah chrysolite suang khat, onyx suang khat, jasper suang khat thuah in. Kham sungah na phumsuk ding hi.
Suang sawm-le-nih om ding hi: khat ciangin Israyl’ tapate min khat ciat tuang ding a, Tuate pen minam sawm-le-nihte min tawh a kigelh seal khat tawh kibang ding hi.
Awmdal aa dingin khau tawh a kibang, a kihual kham citak khainiang bawl in.
Awmdal aa dingin kham kual nih na bawl ding a, awmdal mong nihte ah bulh in.
Awmdal mong-a om a kualte ah kham khainiang nihte bulh in.
Khainiang mong langkhat lamte pen a mai lam siampi puan liangkaihna lam-a kaisuk pen tawh na zom ding hi.
Kham kual nih bawl inla, awmdal mong nih, siampi puan tawh a kizom a sunglamah na bulh ding hi.
Kham kual nih na bawl ding a, siampi puan mailam-a liangkaihna nuai-ah, siampi puan kawnggak tung deuh a khuina tawh a kinai-in bulh in.
Awmdal’ kualte pen siampi puan tunga a kualte ah khau dum tawh a kawnggak ah zomin na khih ding ahi hi; tua hileh awmdal pen siampi puan panin kiveivei lo ding hi.
Mun Siangtho ah Aaron hong lut simin, Yahweh mai-ah phawkna a kizom toto dingin ama lungtang tunga om thukhenna awmdal tungah Israyl tapate’ minte pua ding hi.

Awmdal sungah Urim leh Thummim zong koih ding hi; tua hileh Yahweh’ omna ah amah a lut simin Aaron’ lungtang tungah tuate om ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin Aaron in ama lungtang tungah Israyl mite’ thukhenna Yahweh mai-ah a pua den ding hi.
Siampi puantualpi pen puan dum bek tawh bawl inla,
tua puantual laizang ah, a lutang khum nading a ngawng vang tawh na bawl ding hi. A vang kiimkotah puan ngawng tawh a kibang a kigan tawh a kizim om ding hi; tua hileh tua pen kikeek nawn lo ding hi.
Puantualpi mong kiimkotah a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute tawh a kizem mang kawlsing gah bawl inla, tuate kikal ah kham tawh kibawl long khat bawl in.
Puantualpi mong kiimkotah kham tawh ki bawl long leh mang kawlsing gah cih bangin na kihelhsak ding hi.
Amah si loh nadingin Aaron in biakna nasep a sep ciangin tua pen silh pelmawh ding hi; tua hileh Yahweh mai Mun Siang ah amah a lut ciangin leh a pusuah ciangin tua long ging kiza ding hi.
Kham citak tawh a peek khat bawl inla, seal khat bangin tua tungah : Qodesh la-Yahweh; Yahweh Tungah Siangtho, cih gelh in.
Dialkhip tungah khih nadingin khau dum khat a tungah khih in.

Tua pen Aaron taltang tungah om ding a, Israyl mite in citpiakna siangtho khatpeuh a piakna, a siangtho nate-a mawhna pen amah in pua ding hi. Yahweh mai-ah amaute a kisan theih nadingin tua pen a taltang tungah om den ding hi.
A sung lama kisilh puan pen khau hoih tawh gan inla, khau hoih tawh dialkhip bawl in. Khau kawnggakna pen siamgat nasep tawh a kibawl hi ding hi.
Aaron’ tapate aa dingin puantungsilhte, kawnggakte, leh lukhute minthanna leh hoihna tawh a kidim dingin bawl in.
Amaute in Keima tungah siampi nasep a sep theih nadingun na sanggampa Aaron leh a tapate a siangtho puante silhsak inla, amaute sathau nilhin, nasem dingin kipsakin, na siangthosak ding hi.
A guaktangin a omna uh a tuam dingin a kawng panin a phei dong a tung, a sunglam-a kiteng puanpak na bawlsak ding hi.

Kikhopna Puanbuk ah amaute a lut simun Aaron leh a tapate in teng hamtang ding uh hi; tua bang ahih kei leh Mun Siangtho ah nasem dingin hong neh uh ciangin amaute a mawhlo hilo ding uh a, si ding uh hi. Tua bangin a teng ding uh pen amah leh ama khita a suanlekhakte aa dingin ngeina kip khat hi tawntung ding hi.
Amaute in Keima tungah siampi nasep a sep theih nadingun amaute’ sianthona sehtuam nadingin amaute’ tungah na hih ding hi bang ahi hi: paubanna a nei lo bawngtal no khat leh tuutal nih,
leh silngo sawh loh anlum, sathau a kihel silngo sawh loh mohte, sathau tawh a kizut silngo sawh loh mohphengte la in.
Lawh khat sungah tuate koih inla, tua lawh, tua bawngtal leh tua tuutal nihte tawh biakbuk ah nong paipih ding hi.
Tua ciangin Aaron leh a tapate in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah hong paipih ding a, nangmah in amaute tui tawh na sil ding hi.
Siampi Lian’ siampi puan la inla, puantungsilh, siampi puantualpi, siampi puan, leh awmdal tawh Aaron na silhsak ding hi. Ama tunga siampi puan pen hoihtakin a kigan kawnggak tawh na gak ding hi.
A lu tungah dialkhip khimsak inla, tua dialkhip tungah kham citak tawh a kibawl kumpi’ lukhu siangtho khusak in.
Nilh sathau la inla, ama lu tungah sungsukin nilh in.
Tua khit ciangin nangmah in a tapate na paipih ding a, siampi puantualpite na silhsak ding hi. Amaute tungah puantungsilhte silhsak inla,

Aaron leh a tapate tungah lukhute khusak in. Tua ciangin Aaron leh a tapate’ tungah kawnggak na gak ding hi. Siampi nasepna pen a kip tawntung ngeina ahih manin amau aa hi ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron leh a tapate a tuam vilvelin na kipsak ding hi.
Kikhopna Biakbuk mai-ah bawngtal paipih inla, Aaron leh a tapate in bawngtal’ lu tungah a khutte nga ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ mai, Kikhopna Biakbuk lutna ah nangmah in tua bawngtal na go ding hi.
Nangmah in bawngtal’ sisan na la ding a, biaknatau-a kite tungah na khutme tawh na nuhin, si a om lai teng biaknatau bulah na sungsuk ding hi.
Tua ciangin a gilpi tuam a thau khempeuh, a sin tunga a utok leh a kal nihte leh a kal tuam a thau la inla, biaknatau tungah tuate hal in.
Ahih hangin bawngtal’ sa, a vun, leh a ekte giahphual pua lamah haltum in. Hih pen mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
Tuutalte lak panin khat la inla, Aaron leh a tapate in tuutal’ lu tungah a khutte nga ding uh a,
Tua khit ciangin nangmah in tuutal go-in a si la-in biaknatau kiimkot khempeuh ah na theh ding hi.
Tua ciangin nangmah in tuutal na semnen ding hi; a sungkua leh a khete silin, a sabakte leh a lu tawh tuate koihin,
tua ciangin biaknatau tungah tuutal a buppi-in na hal ding hi. Tua pen Yahweh tungah meitawh kihal biakna, a lungkimhuai gim namtui, Yahweh’ tungah meihal biakna khat ahi hi.
Tua tak ciangin tuutal adang khat pen la inla, Aaron leh a tapate in a lu tungah a khutte nga ding uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin nangmah in tuutal na go ding hi; a si pawl khat la-in, Aaron leh a tapate’ taklam bil teepmong leh amau’ taklam khutpi dawnte leh amau’ taklam khepi dawnte nuhin, si a omlai teng biaknatau kiim khempeuh ah theh ding hi.

Biaknatau tunga om sisan pawl khat leh nilh sathau pawl khat la-in Aaron leh ama Siampi Lian’ siampi puan tung, a tapate leh amaute siampi puantualpite tungah na theh ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah leh a puante, a tapate leh a puante uh sehtuamin a siangtho a hi ding hi.
Hih tuutal nihna panin a thau, a gilpi tuam a thau, a sin pan a utok, a kal nihte, a kal tuam a thau, leh a taklam liangko na la ding hi. Tu-in hih pen sehtuam tuutal ahi hi.
Yahweh mai-a om silngo sawh loh anlum lawh sung panin anlum khat leh sathau tawh a kibawl anlum bek khat, leh moh pheng khat na la ding hi.
Hihte khempeuh Aaron khut leh a tapate khut sungah koih inla, Yahweh mai-ah vei-a piakna-in na vei ding hi.
Tua ciangin amau khutte panin tuate la inla, tuate pen mei tawh a kihal biakna ahi, Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin tuutal masa’ meihal biakna tawh biaknatau tungah na halkhawm ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin nangmah in Aaron’ sehtuam a nihna tuutal’ sa-iik la inla, Yahweh mai-ah vei-a piak dingin na vei ding a, tua pen nangma tanh hi ding hi.
Sehtuam tuutal panin a kipia, a kivei siampite’ tanh a liangko leh vei-a piak sa-iikte siangthosakin na sehtuam ding hi.

Tua pen Aaron leh a tapate aa dingin tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi Israyl mite’ tung panin tanh khat ding ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh kilemna-a amau’ biakna panin Israyl mite in Yahweh tungah a piak hih huhna pen siampite ngah ding ahi hi.
Aaron’ biakna puan siangthote pen ama suanlekhakte aa ding hi ding hi; tua ahih manin amaute sathau kinilhin sehtuam ahi ding uh hi.
Ama Siampi Lian za a luah tapa pen Mun Siangtho sungah nasem dingin Kikhopna Puanbuk ah pai-in nisagih sung a silh ding ahi hi.
Sehtuam tuutal la inla, mun siangtho sung khat ah a sa na huan ding hi.
Aaron leh a tapate in tuutal’ sa leh lawh sunga om silngo sawh loh anlum pen Kikhopna Biakbuk lam kongkhak ah a nek ding uh ahi hi.

Amaute a sehtuam na ding leh a siangthosak dingin mawhkhuhna a kibawlna tua ante amaute in ne ding uh a, ahih hangin a pualam mi khat peuh in tuate ne lo ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh hihte pen a siangtho ahi hi.

Sehtuam biaknate’ sa khat peuhpeuh ahi a, silngo sawh loh anlum khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin zingsang dong a omlai leh, tua ciangin a omlai teng mei tawh na hal tum ding hi. Tuate pen kine lo ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh tuate pen a siangtho ahi hi.
Aaron leh a tapate aa dingin nang kong thupiaksa khempeuh hih inla, amaute na sehtuam nading leh na kipsak nadingin ni sagih sung hunla in.
Mawhkhuhna bawl nadingin mawhna hanga biakna-in ni simin bawngtal khat biakpiakna-in pia ding hi. Tua ading mawhkhuhna bawlna tawh biaknatau siansuah inla na apna-in sathau nilh in.
Biaknatau aa ding ni sagih sung mawhkhuhna bawl inla, siansuah in. Tua ciangin biaknatau a siangtho pen suak ding a, a kisukhak pih peuhmah a siangtho hi pelmawh ding hi.
Hih pen biaknatau tungah ni simin nangmah in na piak ding ahi hi: kum khat a pha tuuno nih, ni khat khit ni khat kizom toto ding hi;
zingsangin khat na pia ding a, adang khat pen tua nitak nih kikalin na pia ding hi.

Tuuno masa tawh a kigawi olive sathau hin khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat tawh a kihel annel ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat leh dawn-a piakna dingin leenggah zu hin khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat tawh na pia ding hi.

Tuuno adang khat pen tua nitak nihte kikal ah na pia ding a, zingsanga mah bangin a lungkimhuai gim namtui, Yahweh kiangah mei tawh kihal biakna-in an tawh biakna leh dawn-a biakna tawh na pia ding hi.
Nang tunga thu kong gen nading, nang tawh Ka kituah nading mun, Yahweh’ mai Kikhopna Puanbuk kongkhak ah a khang a khangin a hunhun-in a kipia ding meihal biakna hi ding hi.
Tua lai-ah zong Israyl mite tawh Ka kituah ding a, biakbuk pen Ka minthanna hangin a siangtho ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Keimah in Kikhopna Puanbuk leh biaknatau sehtuam-in ka siangthosak ding hi. Kei tungah siampi bangin na a sep theih nadingun Aaron leh a tapate zong ka siangthosak ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl mite lakah Kei ka om ding a, amaute’ Vantung Pa ka hi ding hi.
Amaute lakah Ka om na hangin Egypt gam panin a paikhiatpih keimah Yahweh amaute’ Vantung Pa ka hihna hong thei ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh amaute’ Vantung Pa ka hi hi.
Paknamtui hal nading biaknatau khat bawl inla, nangmah in singkha sing tawh na bawl ding hi.

Tua pen a kikim killi nei hi ding a, a dung cubit 1; pi 1 leh letmat 6 kiim, hi ding a, a vai zong cubit 1; pi 1 leh letmat 6 kiim, mah hi ding a, a sanna cubit 2; pi 3 kiim, hi ding hi; a kite pen biaknatau tawh sakhat hi ding hi.
A tung, a pang teng khempeuh, leh a kite kham citak tawh zut inla, a kiimkotah kham geihual na bawl ding hi.
Biaknatau aa dingin tua geihual nuai-ah kham kual nih bawl inla, a puak zelzelna zawlte a len dingin a lang tuak ah a kigalsai-in bawl in.
Singkha sing tawh zawlte bawl inla, kham citak tawh zut in.
Nang tawh kimuh nading mun, Tecipanna tunga hehpihna tokhom mai-a om Tecipanna singkuang mai-a om dalna puan mai-ah paknamtui biaknatau na koih ding hi.
Aaron in meivakte a vil ciangin zingsang simin biaknatau tungah a namtui paknamtui hal pelmawh ding hi.

Amah in nitakin meivakte a vak ciangin amah in paknamtui hal leuleu ding hi; tua hileh Yahweh mai-ah paknamtui pen a hun mantakin kihal ding a, na khang tawntungun Yahweh mai-ah a tatsat lo paknamtui khat a hi ding hi.
Hih biaknatau tungah adang anamtui khat peuhpeuh ahi a, meihal biakna khat peuh hitaleh an tawh biakna hitaleh ahi zongin pia kei inla, dawn-a biakna zong tua tungah na sungsuk kei ding hi.

Biaknatau kite tungah mawhkhuhna dingin mawhna hanga biakna sisan tawh Aaron in kum khatin khatvei mawhkhuhna bawl ding hi; a khang a khangin amah in tua tungah kum khatin khatvei mawhkhuhna bawl ding hi. Hih pen Yahweh’ tungah a siangtho pen ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah:

“Israyl mite a phazah sim dingin mi simna na neih ciangin mi khat peuh in amah a kisim hun-a kipan Yahweh tungah kitatkhiatna pia hamtang ding uh hi. Tua ciangin nangmah in amaute na sim ciangin amaute tungah gimna bangmah tung lo ding hi.

Hih pen a kisimsa mi lak-a khat peuhpeuh in a piak ding uh ahi hi: munsiangtho shekel tawh kizui-in shekel lang; 1/5 ounce, ta pia ding uh hi. Shekel lang pen Yahweh’ tungah biakna-in piakna khat ahi hi.
A kisim lak-a a kihel mi khatpeuh kum 20 leh a tung siah in Yahweh tungah biakpiakna-in pia ding uh hi.
Note aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawl nadingin Yahweh biakna-in na piak uh ciangin a haute in shekel lang sangin a tamzaw pia lo ding a, a zawngte in a tawmzaw pia lo ding hi.

Nomau aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawl nading, Yahweh mai-ah Israyl mite Ka phawkna a hisak dingin Israyl mite tung panin mawhkhuhna sum na la ding a, Kimuhna Biakbuk nasepna aa dingin na koih ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah:
“Kisil nadingin sumngo kuang khat, leh a ngak nadingin sumngo mah tawh bawl in. Nangmah in Kimuhna Biakbuk leh biaknatau kikal ah na koih ding a, tua sungah tui na koih ding hi.
Aaron leh a tapate in a khut uh leh a khe uh tua tui tawh sil ding uh hi.

Kikhopna Puanbuk ah amaute a pai simun, amaute in tui tawh a sil ding uh hi, tua hileh amaute a si lo ding uh hi. Yahweh tungah mei tawh kihal biakna piakna tawh biaknatau nasep sem dingin a neh uh ciangin zong,
Amaute a sih loh nadingun a khutte leh a khete uh sil ding uh hi. A khang a khangin Aaron leh ama suanlekhakte aa dingin tawntung ngeina kip khat ding ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah:
“A hoih pen a namtui nate la in: myrrh paknamtui tui shekel 500; pound 12 ½ kiim, a namtui thaksing tuazah lang shekel 250, paknamtui kilkel shekel 250,
munsiangtho shekel tawh kizui-in thaksing namkhat shekel 500, olive thau hin khat ahi hi.
Paknamtui bawl siamna tawh kizui-in paknamtui bawlte in a gawm bangin nangmah in hihte tawh a siangtho nilh sathau na bawl ding hi. Tua pen a siangtho nilh sathau khat hi ding hi.
Nangmah in tua tawh Kikhopna Puanbuk leh Tecipanna singkuang na zut ding hi;
sabuai leh ama nazat khempeuh, meivakkhuam leh ama nazatte, leh a namtui biaknatau,
meihal biaknatau leh ama nazat khempeuh tawh, kuang leh a ngakna, tuate khempeuh na zut ding hi.
Tuate a siang pen ahih theih nadingin nangmah in tuate na siangsak ding a, amah tawh a kisukha peuhmah a siangtho pelmawh hi ding hi.
Nangmah in Aaron leh a tapate sathau na nilhin siangthosakin, amaute na sehtuam ding hi, tua hileh amaute in Kei tungah siampi nasep hong sem thei ding uh hi.
Nangmah in Israyl mite tungah thu na gen ding a, ‘Hih pen a khang khangin a siangtho Keima sathau nilh hi ding hi.
Mi mawkmawkte’ pumpi tungah tua sathau kisung lo ding a, tua bangin a kigawm dang na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua pen a siangtho hi a, note aa dingin a siangtho hi ding hi.
Tua tawh a kibangin a bawl mi peuhmah ahi a, siampi hiloin a pualam mi khatpeuh tuate a nilhsak mi peuhmah ahi zongin ama mite kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi, Yahweh in ci hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Paknamtui kilkel nate, taaknai, onycha, leh galbanum, leh a paknamtui citak tawh a namtui nate a phazah kikim ciatin la inla,
Paknamtui bawl siamna tawh kizui-in a kigawm bangin a kigawm paknamtui a namtui khat bawl in. Tua pen ci sawhin a nin baanglo, a siangtho hi ding hi.
Nangmah in tua panin kimkhat na gawi vui ding a, nang tawh kimuh nading Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga Tecipanna mai-ah pawlkhat na koih ding hi. Tua pen nangma aa dingin a siangtho pen hi ding hi.
Note aa dingin tua tawh a kibangin na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua pen Yahweh aa dingin a siangtho hi ding hi. Tua pen Biakinn nasep a siangthote aa ding bekin zat ding ahi hi.
Tua tawh a kibangin paknamtui a bawl mi peuhmah ama mite kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi,” a ci hi.

headings.text: Yahweh’ Khutme tawh a Kigelh Thuciamna

verses.text: Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah thu gen a,
“Thei in, Yahdah minam Hur tapa ahi Uri’ tapa Bezaleel ka teelkhin a,
Yahweh’ Kha tawh amah ka dim khin a, siamna, hih theihna, khutsiamna nam khempeuh ah ngaihsut pilna ahi:
kham, ngun, leh sumngo nasepna ah lim hoihte a geel ding;
bulh ding suangte atin a zep nading, singzep nasep a sem ding leh khutsiamna khempeuh a sem thei dingin Ka teelkhin hi.
Amah a huh dingin amah tawh Dan minam Ahisamach’ tapa Oholiab zong ka sehkhin hi. Nang Kong thupiak khempeuh a bawl theih nadingun khutsiam mi khempeuh tungah siamna ka piakhin hi:
Kikhopna Biakbuk, Tecipanna singkuang leh tua tunga om hehpihna tokhom; Mawhkhuhna dinga a khuhna, leh Biakbuk vanzatte khempeuh;
sabuai leh ama vanzatte, a siangtho meivakkhuam ama nazatte khempeuh, paknamtui biaknatau,
meihal biaknatau leh ama vanzatte khempeuh, leh tuikuang leh a tunna,
siampi nasep a sep nadingin a kigan puante; siampi Aaron aa dingin a siangtho puante leh a tapate’ puante,
Mun Siangtho aa dingin nilh sathau leh paknamtui kilkel-te ahi hi. Amaute in hihte khempeuh nang kong thupiakna khempeuh tawh kizui-in a bawl ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopih a, a gen inah:

“Israyl mite kiangah zong gen in, ‘Note in Ka Shabbat-te na tang ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in note hong siangthosak Yahweh ka hihna na theih nadingun tuate pen Kei leh note’ kikalah khang tawntungun ciaptehna lim khat ahi hi.

Note in Shabbat na tang ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen note aa dingin siangtho hi. Zahtak loin a ninsak mi peuhmah kithat taktak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua ni-in na a sem peuhmah, ama mipihte lak panin kikhenkhia ding hi.
Ni guk sungin nasep kizo ding a, ahih hangin a Ni Sagihna ni pen Shabbat khawl ni hi a, Yahweh tungah siangtho hi. Shabbat ni-in na khat peuhpeuh a sem peuhmah kithat taktak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a tawntung thuciamna-in amau’ khang tawntungin Shabbat tangin Israyl mite in Shabbat keem ding uh hi.

Hih pen a tawntungin Keimah leh Israyl mite kikal ah ciaptehna lim khat ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ni guk sungin Yahweh in vantungte leh leitung bawl a, a ni sagih ni-in Amah tawlnga-in a thadimsakkik hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Sinai Mual tungah Yahweh in Mosheh a hopihna a mankhit ciangin, Yahweh’ khutme tawh kigelh suangpeekte ahi Tecipanna suangpeek nih Amah in Mosheh pia hi.

Mualtung panin Mosheh hong tunsuk hakna mite in a theih uh ciangin, Aaron kiimkotah kikaikhawmin ama kiangah, “Hong pai in, kote’ mai-a pai ding pasian (el) khat hong bawlsak in. Egypt leitang panin eite hong paikhiatpih i lawmpa Mosheh bangsuak ta hiam cih kote in ka thei kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Aaron in amaute kiangah, “Na zite, na tapate, leh na tanute’ bil-a kham bilbahte sutkhia unla, ka kiangah hong paipih un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin mi khempeuh in amau’ bilbahte sutkhia-in Aaron kiangah a paipih uh hi.

Amah in amaute’ piakte la-in, sumtui sunna sungah sungin, a kisung bawngno khat bawlsak hi. Tua ciangin mite in, “Israyl aw, hih pen Egypt gam pana note hong paikhiatpih note’ pasian (el) ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Aaron in hih thu a muh ciangin, amah in bawngno mai-ah biaknatau khat lam a, “Zingciang pen Yahweh aa dingin pawi khat ahi hi,” ci-in a zasak hi.
Tua ahih manin a zingciangin mite thobaih uh a, meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate pia hi; mite anne tui dawn dingin tu uh a, tua khit ciangin numei pasal kino kisawk dingin a dingto uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Paisuk in! Bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt leitang panin na paikhiatpih na mite kisiagawp zo uh hi.

Ka thupiakna lampi panin manlang takin amaute kiheikhia khin uh hi. Amau aa dingin amaute in a kisung bawngno khat bawlin, tua bia-in a tungah biakna pia uh a, “Israyl aw, hih pen Egypt gam panin note hong paikhiatpih na pasian (el) uh ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Hih mite Ka mukhin a, amaute a genhak mahmah;ngawng khuah, mite a hi taktak uh hi!
Tu-in tua ahih manin amaute tungah Ka hehna a kuan theih nading leh amaute Ka haltum theih nadingin kei guak hong omsak in; nangmah minam lian khatin Kong bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Mosheh in Yahweh a Vantung Pa kiangah thumin, “Yahweh aw, vanglian thupi leh a thahatna khut tawh Nangmah in Egypt gam panin na paikhiatpih Na mite’ tungah bang hangin na hehna kuangsak na hi hiam?

Bang hangin Egypt mite in genin, ‘Mualtungah amaute a that ding leh leitung panin amaute a beisak dingin siatna ngaihsutna tawh Amah in amaute paikhiatpih hi,’ ci ding uh hilo ahi hiam? A kihtakhuai na hehna panin kihei inla, Na mite tungah a tung ding hih siatna panin na lungsim khiam in.

Amaute tungah Nangmahmah-in kiciamin, ‘Na suanlekhakte uh vantung aksite bangin tampi Ka phasak ding a, Keimah in Ka ciamsa hih leitang khempeuh na suanlekhakte uh tungah pia-in amaute in luah tawntung ding uh hi,’ na cihna Na nasemte ahi Abraham, Isaac leh Israyl-te phawk in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a mite’ tungah Amah in ahih dinga a gen siatna panin Yahweh in a lungsim a khiam hi.

Tua ciangin Mosheh kihei-in a khut sungah Tecipanna suangpeek nihte tawh mualtung panin a paisuk hi. Suangpeekte a langnih tuak tungah kigelh a; a pang langkhat lam leh adang langkhat lam tungah tuate a kigelh hi.
Suangpeekte pen Yahweh bawlsa hi a, suangpeekte tunga khuakin a kigelhte Yahweh gelh ahi hi.
Nun tapa Yahshua in mite awnggawpin amaute gamlumna a zak ciangin amah in Mosheh kiangah, “Giahphual ah kido-a gamlumna om hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, “Tua pen zawhna kikona awging hilo a, lelhna sunga a kiko mite awging zong hilo hi. Tua pen keima zak lasakna awging ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Giahphual nai-ah Mosheh hong tun’ phetin, amah in bawngno leh lamna a mu hi. Tua ahih manin Mosheh’ hehna kuang a, amah in a khut panin suangpeekte lawnkhia-in, mual bul ah tuate a sukham hi.
Tua tak ciangin amah in amaute bawlsa bawngno la-in mei tawh hal a, gawivui-in tui tungah theh a, tua tui Israyl mite a dawnsak hi.
Mosheh in Aaron kiangah, “Amaute tungah mawhna lianpi na tut nadingin hih mite in nang tungah bang hong gamta uh ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Aaron in, “Heh kei in. Siatna lam ah bangzah takin a awn hih mite na thei hi.
Amaute in kei kiangah, ‘Kote’ mai-a pai ding pasian khat hong bawlsak in. Egypt leitang panin eite hong paikhiatpih i lawmpa Mosheh bangsuak ta hiam cih kote in ka thei kei uh hi,’ hong ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in amaute kiangah, ‘Kizepna kham a nei peuhmah in suahkhia un,’ ka ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in tua kham kei hong pia uh a, keimah in mei sungah lawnsukin tua ciangin hih bawngno hong pusuakkhia hi,” a ci hi.
Mite ukzawhin a om lohna leh Aaron in khaam zo loin hih bangin a galte ciamnuihna suak hi, ci-in Mosheh in mu hi;
tua ciangin giahphual lutna ah Mosheh dingto-in, “Yahweh’ lam-a a om peuhmah ka kiangah hong paisak un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Levi mite khempeuh ama kiangah amau-le-amau hong kikaikhawm uh hi.

Amah in amaute kiangah, “Hih pen Israyl Pa, Yahweh in a gen ahi hi: ‘A milipin a namsau uh a pangah tawi-in giahphual sung zui-in mong khat pan adang mong khat dong pai henla, mikim in a sanggampa, a kikholhpihpa, leh a vengpa peuhmah that ta hen,’ ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ahih manin Levi mite in Mosheh thupiak bangin gamta uh a, tua ni-in mipi laka mi 3,000 kiimbang si hi.

Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in, “Tu ni-in note tungah Yahweh in thupha hong piak theih nadingin tuni-in no-le-no Ama tungah kiseh tuam un; bang hang hiam cihleh mi khempeuh in ama tapa leh ama sanggampa langpang khin hi,” a ci hi.
A zingciangin Mosheh in mite kiangah, “Note in mawhna lianpi na bawlkhin uh hi. Ahih hangin tu-in Yahweh kiangah ka paito ding a, note aa dingin mawhkhuhna ka va bawl thei kha ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh kiangah Mosheh paikik a, “Aw, hih mite in mawhna lianpi khat bawlkhin uh a, amaute aa dingin kham pasian (el) khat bawlkhin uh hi!
Ahih hangin tu-in, hong thuum ing, amaute’ mawhna maisak in; ahi zongin na maisak kei ding leh, Na gelhsa na laibu panin kei hong phiatkhia in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh dawngkik a, “Kei’ tungah hong mawh mi peuhmah, Ka laibu sung panin ka phiatkhia ding hi.
Tu-in pai in, ka genna mun ah mite mapi inla, na mai-ah Ka vantungmi pai ding hi. Ahih hangin Ka dantat ding hun hong nai ciangin, Keimah in mawhna hangin amaute’ tungah dantatna Ka tun ding hi.
Amaute in Aaron’ bawlsa bawngno tawh a gamtatna uh hangin Yahweh in pulnatna khat tawh mite vat hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Dingkhia un, Abraham, Isaac, leh Yaaqob tungah, ‘Na suanlekhakte tungah Ka pia ding hi,’ ci-in Ka ciamna leitang ah Egypt gam panin na paikhiatpih mite leh nang hih lai mun panin paito un.
Keimah in note mai-ah vantungmi khat ka sawl ding a, Canaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite leh Yebus mite Ka hawlkhia ding hi.
Bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna gam ah paito un; ahang in note lakah kong pai kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note a genhak mite na hi uh a, Keimah in lamkal ah ka hong susia kha ding hi.
Mite in hih a lungkhamhuai kammalte a zak uh ciangin, amaute thuum uh a, khatbeek in kizepnate a zang kei uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Israyl mite kiangah, ‘Note pen a genhak mi na hi uh hi. Note lak tomno sung bekbek nangawn kong paipih zo kei ding a, kong beisak kha ding hi. Tu-in tua ahih manin, note bang kong cih ding hiam cih Ka theih matengin na kizepnate uh suahkhia un,’ ci hi,” ci-in a genkhinzo hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl mite in Horeb Mual kiangah amau kizepnate a suahkhia uh hi.

Tu-in Mosheh in a puanbuk la-in giahphual pualam giahphual panin a gamla pek ah puanbuk lam a, tua pen Kikhopna Puanbuk a ci hi. Yahweh tungah thu a dong nuam mi peuhmah in giahphual pualam-a Kikhopna Puanbuk ah paikhia uh hi.
Puanbuk ah Mosheh a pai peuhpeuh ciangin mi khempeuh dingto-in, a milipin a puanbuk kong ciat uh ah dingin puanbuk sungah Mosheh a tumkhit matengin en gige uh hi.
Puanbuk sungah Mosheh a tum phetin meii khuampi hong kumsuk a, Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah thu a gen sungteng puanbuk kongkhak ah tua meii khuampi om hi.
Mite in puanbuk lutna panin puanbuk dong meii khuampi a ding gige a muh simun, amaute khempeuh in amau puanbuk lutna ciat ah dingin a bia uh hi.

Mi khat peuh ama lawm tawh a kiho bangin Yahweh in Mosheh maitang kituahin hopih hi. Giahphual ah amah hong ciahkik a, ahih hangin Nun tapa ama nasem Yahshua, tangvalnopa, biakbuk panin hong paikhia lo hi.

Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in Yahweh kiangah, “Nangmah in kei tungah ‘Mite makaih in,’ nong ci hi, ahih hangin kei tawh nong sawlkhop ding nong gen nai kei hi. Nangmah in, ‘Na minin nang kong thei a, ka mai-ah maipha zong na mukhin hi,’ nong cikhin hi.

Tu-in tua ahih manin keimah in kong thuum hi, Na muhna ah maipha ka muh leh keimah in nang kong theih nading leh Na maipha ka muh paisuak theih nadingin Nangma dan hong hilh in. Hih minamte pen Nangma mite ahihna zong phawk in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in, “Ka Ompihna nang tawh ton ding a, tawldamna kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in Ama kiangah, “Nangma Ompihna kote tawh a ton kei zenzen leh, hih lai mun panin kote hong paisakto kei in.

Nangmah kote tawh nong ton keileh, keimah leh Na mite tunga na lungkim lam bangci bangin kithei ding ahi hiam? Leitung maitang-a om midang khempeuh panin keimah leh Nangma mite khempeuh a tuam ka hihna uh kilamdanna om nawn ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Nong gen thu keimah in ka hih takpi ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh Ka mitte ah nangmah in maipha na ngah a, na minin nangmah kong thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in, “Na minthanna tu-in kei hong lak in,” a ci hi.

Yahweh in, “Keimah in ka thumanna khempeuh na mai-ah ka paisak ding hi; Keimah in note omna ah ka Min, YAHWEH ka tangko ding hi. ka lainatnop mite ka lainat ding a, ka hehpihnop mite ka hehpih ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Amah in, “Kei hong mute kua mah nungta lo ahih manin Ka maitang na mu thei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in, “Suang tung khat ah na din nading Keima kiangah mun khat om hi.
Ka minthanna vang in hong nawk laitakin suanghawm sungah nang kong koih ding a, Ka hong nawk laitakin Ka khut tawh nang kong hum ding hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in Ka khut ka lakhia ding a, nangmah in Ka nung mu-in, ahih hangin ka maitang a kimu peuhmah kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “A masa tawh a kibangin suangpeek nih sui inla, na sukkhap a masa suangpeekte tunga om thupiakte mah tua suangpeekte tungah Ka gelh ding hi.
Zingsangin kigingsa-in om inla, Sinai Mual tungah zingsangin hong paito-in, mual dawn tua munah Keima kiangah nang mahmah hong kilaak in.
Kuamah nong tonpih kei ding hi, mualtung khempeuh ah kuamah omsak kei inla; tuuhonte leh bawnghonte nangawn mual mai-ah a gamtasak kei ding hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in a masa bangin suangpeek nih a sui hi. Tua ciangin zingsangin Mosheh thobaihin Yahweh in amah a thupiaksa bangin Sinai Mual tungah amah paito a, tua suangpeek nihte a tawi hi.
Tua ciangin meii lakah Yahweh kumsukin tua lai-ah Mosheh tawh dingkhawm a, YAHWEH Min a tangko hi.
Yahweh in ama mai nawkin, “YAHWEH, Vanglian Pen YAHWEH, hehpihna leh lainatna tawh a kidim, lungduai-in thuman leh thutak tawh a kidim,

tul tampite aa dingin hehpihna a nei; khialhna, thupalsatna leh mawhna-te maisakin; ahih hangin a mawh mite dantat loin cikmahin nusia ngei lo a, pate’ mawhna tate’ tung leh tute’ tung, khang thum khang lina dong a thukkikpa,” ci-in a tangko hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh leilak lamah manlang taka lukunsukin, a bia hi.

Tua tak ciangin amah in, “Yahweh aw, na mai-ah maipha ka ngah leh ka Vantung Pa ko tawh hong ton in, kong thuum hi. A genhak mite himah tale-ung, kote khialhna leh kote mawhna hong maisak inla, Nangma neihsa van-le-na dingin kote hong sang in,” a ci hi.

Amah in, “Nangmah tawh thuciamna khat ka bawl ding a; Na mite khempeuh mai-ah, leitung khempeuh hitaleh minam khatpeuh sungah hitaleh cikmahin tua bang a kibawl ngei lo na lamdangte Ka bawl ding a, note’ lak-a a om mite khempeuh in Yahweh’ nasepna mu ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh note’ tungah kong bawl ding na pen a kihtakhuai mahmah na ahi hi.
Tu ni-a kong thupiak zui in. Nangma mai panin Canaan mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite, leh Yebus mite Ka hawlkhia ding hi.
Na pai nading leitang-a a teng mite tawh thukimna khat zong na bawl loh nading kidawm mahmah in, tua bang hi keileh amaute pen note lakah thangzak khat hong hi ding hi.
Nangmah in amau’ biaknataute na susia ding a, amau’ biakna khuampite sukhamin, amau’ khuam siangthote; Asherah khuamte, na sattan ding hi.
Note in a kikham pasiante (elohim) na bia peuhmah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a haza Yahweh pen pasiante khat peuhpeuh hangin a thangpai a haza Pa khat ahi hi.

Tua gam-a a tengte tawh thukimna khat mahmah zong na bawl loh nadingun kidawm un; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in a pasiante tungah amau-le-amau paktatna bawlin biakpiakna a piak uh ciangin amaute in note hong samin note in amau’ biakpiaknate na ne kha ding uh hi.
Na tapate aa dingin amau tanute’ la-in, amau tanute in a pasiante tungah paktatna bawlin, na tapate zong amaute tawh paktat kha ding hi.
Note aa dingin a kisung pasiante (elohim ahikeileh teraphim) na bawl kei ding uh hi.

Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi na bawl ding uh hi. A kisehsa Abib Kha; Mangbuh-ah a vuih thak Kha, sungin Keimah in nang kong thupiak bangin ni sagih sung note in silngo sawh loh anlum bek na ne ding uh hi.
Na ganhingte uh tacilte bawnghonte leh tuuhonte dongin apa peuhmah, naubu a hong masa suanlekhak peuhmah kei aa ahi hi.

Ahih hangin laa tacil khat peuh pen tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding uh hi. Note in tua pen na tat kei uh leh, a ngawng na kuaitan ding uh hi. Na ta pasalte tacil khempeuh na tanh ding uh hi. Khut hawmguak tawh Ka mai-ah kuamah hong kilaak lo ding hi.
Ni guk sungin nasep kizokhin ding a, ahih hangin a ni sagih ni-in note na tawlnga ding uh hi. Lo khawh hun leh anlak hunin zong note na tawlnga ding uh hi.

Anlak cianga mangbuh anpalte tawh Kalte’ Pawi na bawl ding uh a, a tungzel pawi; tekufah, hun sung, Yahweh’ Kum Siangtho a bei hun, phalbi khuahun kipatkuan hun sungin Kaihkhopna Pawi na bawl ding uh hi.
Israyl’ Vantung Pa, Yahweh mai-ah pasal khempeuh kum khatin thumvei kilaak ding uh hi.

Keimah in note mai panin minamte ka hawlkhia ding a, note’ gamgite ka keek ding hi; Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah kum khatin thumvei a kilaak dingin na paitoh ciangun na leitang uh kuamah in hong deihgawh lo ding hi.
Silngo khat peuh tawh Ka biakpiakna sisan na hong piakhawm kei ding uh a, Paisan Pawi biakpiakna zingsang dong na omsak kei ding uh hi.
Na lo panin anpalte lakah a tung masa pen note Pa, Yahweh’ Inn ah na paipih ding uh hi. Note in keelno a pi’ nawizu tawh na huan kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Hih thute gelh in, bang hang hiam cihleh hih thute tawh kizui-in nang leh Israyl tawh thuciamna khat ka bawlkhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh tua lai mun ah Yahweh tawh sun 40 leh zan 40 om hi; amah in an ne loin tui zong dawn lo hi. Yahweh in suangpeekte tungah thupiak sawm ahi thuciamna kammalte a gelh hi.
Sinai Mual panin Mosheh, a khut sunga Tecipanna suangpeekte tawh hong paisuk ciangin, Yahweh tawh kiholim ahih manin a mai vun a taan lam Mosheh in thei lo hi,
Aaron leh Israyl mi khempeuh in Mosheh a muh ciangin, a mai vun taang a, ama nai-ah a pai ding uh amaute a lau uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in amaute sam a, Aaron leh mihon makaite khempeuh ama kiangah hong pai uh hi; tua ciangin amaute tawh Mosheh a kiho hi.
Tua khit ciangin, Israyl mite khempeuh in a kiangah hong neh uh a, Yahweh in Sinai Mual tunga a gensa khempeuh Thukham khatin amah in amaute pia hi.
Amaute tungah Mosheh thugenna a mankhit ciangin, a maitang maikhuhna khat a khuh hi.

Ahih hangin Amah tawh kiho dingin Yahweh mai-ah a pai simin, amah a pusuahkik matengin amah in a maikhuhna lakhia hi. Yahweh in bang thupia hiam cih Israyl mite tungah a gen dingin amah hong pusuah ciangin,
amaute in ama maitang taang a mu uh hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh tawh kiho dingin amah a lutkik mateng Mosheh in a maitang maikhuhna a khuhkik hi.
Tua ciangin Mosheh in Israyl mi honpi khempeuh kaikhawmin, amaute tungah, “Hihte pen Yahweh in note’ hih ding-a hong thupiak Thukhamte ahi hi:
Ni guk sungin na kisem ding a, ahih hangin a ni sagihna pen note aa dingin a siangtho ni, Yahweh tungah tawlngak Shabbat ni ahi hi. Tua ni-in nasep khatpeuh a sem mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Shabbat ni-in na tenna khempeuh uh ah mei na cih kei ding uh hi.
Mosheh in Israyl mihonpi khempeuh kiangah, “Yahweh thupiak hih bang ahi hi:
Na neih peuhpeuh panun, Yahweh aa dingin biakna na pia ding uh hi. Piaknopna lungsim a nei peuhmah in Yahweh tungah biakna-in kham, ngun leh sumngo,
a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khau leh a kopin a kikhuk puan hoihte, keelmul,
a kisansak tuutal vunte, keelvunte leh singkha sing,
meivak aa dingin olive sathau, nilh sathau aa ding leh paknamtui kilkel aa dingin a namtuite,
siampipuan tung leh awmdal tunga suan dingin onyx suangte leh adang suang manphate na paipih ding uh hi.
Note lak panin siamna a nei khempeuh hong pai unla, Yahweh thupiaksa na khempeuh na bawl ding uh hi:
Biakbuk leh ama puanbuk, ama khuhna, ama vankhaina-te, a khuampeekte, a zawlkalte, khuamte, leh a bullente,
singkuang leh ama zawlte, leh hehpihna tokhom; Mawhkhuhna, leh tua teng a dal Dalna puan,
sabuai leh ama zawlte leh a nazatte khempeuh, leh Ompihna anlum,
khuavak dingin meivakkhuam zong ama nazatte tawh leh a meivakte tawh, leh meivak aa dingin sathau;
paknamtui biaknatau leh ama zawlte, nilh sathau, leh a namtui paknamtui, biakbuk lutna kong lampi aa dingin kong puan,
meihal biaknatau, a sumngo siklen, a zawlte, a nazatte khempeuh, kuang leh a ngakna tawh,
buktual a puankhaite, a khuampite leh a bullente tawh, buktual lutna aa dingin kong puankhai,
biakbuk leh buktual aa dingin puanbuk khetphimte, leh a khauhualte,

Amah in Ama Kha tawh pilna, telna, theihna leh nasep siamna nam khempeuh tawh amah dimin,

Tua ciangin Mosheh in thupia a, amaute in giahphual buppi tangkosak uh a, “Pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh kuamah in biakbuk siangtho aa dingin pia thuah nawn kei un,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin mite in a piak ding kikho hi;

Nasem mite lak panin a siam mite khempeuh in hoih takin a kikhuk puan hoih dalna puan sawm, leh a dum, a dupsan, a ausan, khutsiamte in cherub-te tawh a zep dalna puan tawh biakbuk a bawl uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in kham kilhna 50 bawlin, biakbuk bupkhat a suah nadingin, dalna puan kopnihte a gakkhop nadingin a zang uh hi.
