Dalna puan sawm-le-khat-te khempeuh kikim a, a dung cubit 30; pi 45 kiim, hi a, a vai cubit 4; pi 6 kiim, ahi hi.
Amaute dalna puan ngate kopkhat ahi dingin pehkhawm uh a, adang gukte kopkhatin pehkhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in dalna puan kopkhat mong nawl dungsuk leh adang dalna puan kopkhat mong nawl dungsuk ah zong bilvang 50 bawl uh hi.
Bupkhat-a puanbuk a gakkhop nadingin amaute in sumngo kilhna 50 a bawl uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in puanbuk khuh nadingin a kisansak tuutal vunte bawl uh a, tuate’ tungah keel vunte tawh khuhna khat a bawl uh hi.

Khuampeek khat pen a tun cubit 10; pi 15 kiim, hi a, a vai cubit 1 ½; pi 2 leh letmat 3 kiim,
khatlekhat a bulhkhop nadingin a tonkhawmin a dawk nih tawh hi ding hi. Biakbuk khuampeekte khempeuh tua bangin na bawl ding hi.
Amaute in biakbuk leitaw lam aa dingin khuampeek 20 bawl uh a,
tuate’ bulah bullen ngun 40 bawlin: khuampeek khat ciat aa dingin bullen nih, a dawkkhia khat ciat nuai ah khat ta hi ding hi.
A langkhat lam, biakbuk’ leilu lam aa dingin amaute in khuampeek 20 bawl uh a,
bullen ngun 40, khuampeek khat ciat nuai ah nihta a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in a nung lam mong, biakbuk’ nitumna lam aa dingin khuampeek guk bawl uh a,
biakbuk nunglam kiute aa dingin khuampeek nih a kibawl hi.
Hih a kiu nihte ah, khuampeekte a bul panin a dawn dongah a kop hi a, kual khat sungah a kikhum khawm hi a, alang nih tuakin tua bang danin a kibawl ahi hi:
Tua ahih ciangin khuampeek giat, bullen ngun 16, khuampeek khat ciat nuai-ah bullen nihta om hi.

adang langkhat khuampeek dingin nga bawl uh a, nitumna lam, biakinn nunglam-a khuampeek dingin zong nga mah bawl uh hi.

Amaute in a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih tawh Dalna puan bawl uh a, khutsiamte in cherub-te tawh a zem hi.
Amaute in tua puan aa dingin singkha sing khuampi li bawl uh a, kham a zut uh hi. Amaute in tuate aa dingin kham vankhaina bawl uh a, tuate aa dingin ngun bullen li a sung uh hi.

Amah in a sunglam leh a pualam kham citak tawh zut a, a kiimkotah kham geihual khat a bawl hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in kham a kiseek tawh cherub nih bawl a, a sin; hehpihna tokhom, mong tuak ah a bawl hi.

Amah in singkha sing tawh sabuai bawl a, a dung cubit 2; pi 3 kiim, a vai cubit 1; pi 1 leh letmat 6, a sanna cubit 1 ½; pi 2 leh letmat 3, ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in kham citak tawh sabuai zut a, a kiimkotah kham geihual khat a bawl hi.
Tua banah amah in a kiimkotah khut peek cia a pha zawl khat bawl a, tua zawl tungah kham geihual khat a bulh hi.
Sabuai aa dingin amah in kham kual li sung a, a khe lite omna a kiuli-te ah a gak hi.
Sabuai puak nadinga a kizang zawlte a len dingin a zawl nai-ah a kual-te a om hi.
Sabuai puak nading zawlte pen singkha sing tawh a kibawl hi a, kham tawh a kizut ahi hi.
Amah in sabuai aa ding kham citak vanzatte ahi: pakante, sikkeu letna saute, kuangukte, leh dawn-a biakna buahsuk nadingin thawl gongbak letna neite a bawl hi.
Amah in kham citak a kiseek meivakkhuam zong bawl hi. Meivakkhuam a bul leh a kungte pen ama seek hi a, paak tawh a kibang a haite, a nunte, leh a paakte pen meivakkhuam tawh sakhat ahi hi.

Amah in singkha sing zawlte bawl a, kham tawh a zut hi.

Amah in singkha sing tawh meihal biaknatau bawl a, a sanna cubit 3; pi 4 leh letmat 6 kiim, ahi hi. A dung a vai a kikim killi nei hi ding a, a dung cubit 5; pi 7 leh letmat 6 kiim, a vai cubit 5; pi 7 leh letmat 6 kiim, ta hi ding hi
Amah in a kiu lite ah a kite bawl hi, tua hi-a a kite leh biaknatau sakhat ahi hi. Amah in sumngo tawh a zut hi.

Amah in biaknatau aa dingin a vang simsiam khat bawl hi: biaknatau lang ciang a banto a kawng nuai tan khawng ah om dingin sumngo tawh kibawl siklen khat a bawl hi.
Amah in sumngo siklen kiu lite aa ding zawlte a len dingin kual li a sung hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in buktual bawl hi: Leitaw lam a sauna cubit 100; pi 150 kiim, hi a, a kopin a kikhuk a kigan dalna puan hoihte,
khuampi 20 leh bullen 20, leh khuampite tungah ngun tawh kibawl vankhainate leh a gaknate tawh ahi hi;
Leilu lam zong a sauna cubit 100; pi 150 kiim, mah hi a, khuampite tungah ngun tawh kibawl a vankhainate leh a gaknate tawh khuampi 20 leh sumngo bullen 20 a nei hi.

A phum nading-a kibawl kham kuakte sungah onyx suangte phumin, Seal-te a kikhuak bangin tuate tungah Israyl’ tapate minte a khuak uh hi.
